safi-cedvel:11-11.t:
* I'rab:
(يوصي) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (في أولاد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يوصيكم), and there is an omitted muḍāf in it, i.e. "the affair of your children", and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (للذكر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (مثل) a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative [Note: with omission of the qualified noun, the adjective standing in its place, i.e.: a share like the share of the two females.], (حظّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الأنثيين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (الفاء) resumptive — or conjunctive —; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (كنّ) a defective past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) ... and (النون) the noun of kāna; (نساء) the khabar of kāna, accusative (manṣūb); (فوق) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (نساء); (اثنتين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اللام) a preposition and (هنّ) an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (ثلثا) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the alif; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (ترك) a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he", i.e. the deceased, and the referring pronoun is omitted, i.e. "he left it"; (الواو) conjunctive; (إن) like the first; (كانت) a defective past verb in the position of the jussive [Translator's note: the source prints «جرم», evidently a misprint for «جزم».] as the protasis ... and (التاء) is for the feminine, and the noun of kāna is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "she", i.e.: the female child; (واحدة) the khabar of kāna, accusative; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (لها النصف) like (لهنّ ثلثا). (الواو) resumptive; (لأبوي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (لكلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, a badal (substitute) of the genitive (أبويه), with repetition of the preposition; (واحد) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive [Note: (منهما): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of (واحد).] (السدس) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (من) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (السدس); (ترك) like the first; (إن كان) like (إن كانت); (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar of kāna; (ولد) the noun of kāna, nominative [Note: or the fāʿil of complete kāna, with (ل) attached to the verb.], (الفاء) conjunctive; (إن) like the first; (لم) a particle of negation only; (يكن) a defective imperfect verb, jussive as the protasis [Note: and according to the opinion of some grammarians it is made jussive by (لم), because it is the stronger.]. (له ولد) like the first; (الواو) parenthetical; (ورث) a past verb and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (أبوا) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the alif, and the nūn was dropped because of the iḍāfa, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (لأمّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, fronted khabar, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (الثلث) a delayed mubtadaʾ. (الفاء) resumptive; (إن كان له إخوة) like (إن كان له ولد); (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (لأمّه السدس) like (لأمه الثلث); (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the operation of the preceding apportionment, i.e. to (يوصيكم) and what follows it [Note: or attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "they are entitled to that after a bequest ..."], (وصية) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (يوصي) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he", i.e. the deceased; (الباء) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يوصي), (أو) a conjunction; (دين) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (وصيّة), genitive like it.
The clause «يوصيكم الله ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «للذكر مثل..» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption — or explicative —. The clause «إن كنّ نساء ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive — or conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «لهنّ ثلثا ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of a jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ترك» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «إن كانت واحدة» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause (إن كنّ ...).
The clause «لها النصف» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «لأبويه ... السدس» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ترك (the second)» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «كان له ولد» has no grammatical position, resumptive ... and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: (فلأبويه ... السدس).
The clause «لم يكن له ولد» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause (كان له ولد).
The clause «ورثه أبواه..» has no grammatical position, parenthetical.
The clause «لأمه الثلث» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «كان له إخوة» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لأمه السدس» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يوصي بها» is in the position of the genitive as a naʿt of (وصيّة).
(آباء) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (أبناء) maʿṭūf to (آباء), nominative like it, and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (لا) negative; (تدرون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أيّ) a relative noun [Note: this is the choice of Abū Ḥayyān.. and some make it an interrogative noun, a nominative mubtadaʾ whose khabar is (أقرب), and the clause is the mafʿūl bihi of the verb (تدرون), which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.], indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, its governor being (تدرون), and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (أقرب) the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "they"; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أقرب); (نفعا) tamyīz (specification), accusative; (فريضة) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), a maṣdar (verbal noun) confirming the content of the preceding sentence, since the meaning of (يوصيكم الله) is "Allah has made obligatory upon you" [Note: so it is either a substitute for the maṣdar because the two verbs are synonymous, or a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, i.e. "Allah has made that obligatory as an obligation".], (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (فريضة); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (كان) a defective past verb, and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "He"; (عليما) the khabar of kāna, accusative; (حكيما) a second khabar, accusative.
The clause «آباؤكم ...» لا تدرون [Translator's note: the source places «لا تدرون» outside the quotation marks; reproduced as written.] has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا تدرون..» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (آباء).
The clause «(هم) أقرب» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (أيّهم).
The clause «... فريضة من الله» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إنّ الله كان..» has no grammatical position, resumptive and causal.
The clause «كان عليما ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.

* Morphology:
(السدس): a noun for the number denoting one of six parts; its pattern is فعل with two ḍammas.
(أمّ): a noun for one of the two parents; it is non-derived (jāmid); its pattern is فعل with ḍamma on the fāʾ, and its ʿayn and lām have been assimilated because they are one letter ...

* Benefits:
1- This verse [Note: and the verse after it.] counts as one of the verses of the science of inheritance, whose details the rulings of the Noble Quran have undertaken. From this legislation arose a purely Islamic science called «ʿilm al-farāʾiḍ» (the science of inheritance shares); scholars have given it special attention, and later it came to have scholars specialised in dividing the estate in accordance with these verses.

safi-cedvel:12-12.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (نصف) a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ترك) a past verb; (أزواج) fāʿil (agent), nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (لم) a particle of negation only; (يكن) a defective — or complete — imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), (لهنّ) like (لكم), attached to an omitted khabar of (يكن) — or attached to (يكن) —; (ولد) the noun of (يكن) — or its fāʿil —, nominative; (الفاء) conjunctive; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (كان) a defective — or complete — past verb, in the position of the jussive as the protasis; (لهنّ ولد) like the first; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لكم الرّبع) like (لكم النصف); (من) a preposition; ما a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (الربع); (تركن) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... and (النون) the fāʿil; (من بعد وصيّة) its i'rab has passed [Note: in the preceding verse (11).], (يوصين) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural ... and (النون) the fāʿil; (الباء) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (يوصين), (أو) a conjunction; (دين) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (وصيّة), genitive like it; (الواو) conjunctive; (لهنّ الربع ممّا تركتم) like (لكم ... تركن); (إن لم يكن لكم ولد) like (إن لم يكن لهنّ ولد); (الفاء) conjunctive; (إن كان لكم ولد فلهنّ الثمن مما تركتم من بعد وصية) like (إن كان لهنّ ولد فلكم الربع مما تركن من بعد وصيّة); (توصون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أو دين) like the first.
The clause «لكم نصف ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ترك أزواجكم» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (ما).
The clause «لم يكن لهنّ ولد» has no grammatical position, resumptive ... and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: (فلكم نصف ما ترك ...).
The clause «كان لهنّ ولد» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «لكم الربع» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «تركن» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «لهنّ الرّبع» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause (لكم نصف ...) [Note: it may be resumptive without conjunction.].
The clause «تركتم [Translator's note: the closing quotation mark is missing in the source.] has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the third relative (ما).
The clause «لم يكن لكم ولد [Translator's note: the closing quotation mark is missing in the source.] has no grammatical position, resumptive ... and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: (فلهنّ الربع).
The clause «كان لكم ولد» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause (لم يكن لكم ...).
The clause «لهنّ الثمن» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «تركتم (the second)» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the fourth relative (ما).
(الواو) resumptive; (إن كان) like the first; (رجل) the noun of kāna — or fāʿil —, nominative; (يورث) a passive imperfect verb, nominative, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he"; (كلالة) ḥāl, accusative (manṣūb) [Note: there are many interpretations of the i'rab of (كلالة), according to the differing meanings and explanations of the word. We quote below the interpretations and derivations of it given in the tafsīr al-Baḥr al-Muḥīṭ of Abū Ḥayyān. He said: «.... The meaning of al-kalāla is that it is the deceased or the heir; so (الكلالة) is accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun latent in (يورث), and if it applies to the heir it is necessary to supply "possessing kalāla" ... And if the meaning of al-kalāla is kinship, then it is accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "he is inherited from because of the kalāla" ... And if (كان) is defective and al-kalāla means the deceased, (يورث) may be an adjective and (كلالة) accusative as the khabar of kāna; in the meaning of the heir, that is possible with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "and if a man inherited from is possessing kalāla". ʿAṭāʾ said: al-kalāla is the property, so (كلالة) is accusative as a second object, whether the verb is built for the active or the passive. Ibn Zayd said: al-kalāla is the inheriting, and it is accusative as a ḥāl or as a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar, its implied form being "an inheriting of kalāla" ... etc.» End quote.], (أو) a conjunction; (امرأة) maʿṭūf to (رجل), nominative like it; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (له) like (لكم), attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (أخ) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (أخت) maʿṭūf to (أخ) by the conjunction (أو), nominative like it [Translator's note: the source text reads «(أخت) معطوف على أخ بحرف العطف (أو) مرفوع مثله», which places (أو) in parentheses as if a separate head; rendered according to the evident sense.]; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (لكلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (واحد) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (من) a preposition; (هما) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (واحد); (السدس) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الفاء) conjunctive; (إن) a conditional particle; (كانوا) a defective past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ...
and the wāw is the noun of kāna; (أكثر) khabar, accusative; (من) a preposition; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to (أكثر), and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (هم) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ; (شركاء) khabar, nominative; (في الثلث) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (شركاء); (من بعد وصيّة يوصى بها أو دين) like its counterpart given earlier in the previous verse, and (يوصى) is passive, and there is a latent pronoun in it as nāʾib fāʿil; (غير) ḥāl, accusative, of the bequeather understood from His words (يوصى بها); (مضار) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (وصيّة) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, accusative; (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of (وصيّة); (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (عليم) khabar, nominative; (حليم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «إن كان رجل ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يورث كلالة» is in the position of the nominative as a naʿt of (رجل).
The clause «له أخ ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun of (يورث).
The clause «لكلّ واحد منهما السدس» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «كانوا أكثر ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause
the last one.
The clause «هم شركاء» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
The clause «يوصى بها» is in the position of the genitive as a naʿt of (وصيّة).
The clause «وصيّة من الله» has no grammatical position, resumptive — or parenthetical.
The clause «الله عليم ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive or conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(يوصين): it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by deletion; its original form is يوصيين, and the deletion in it proceeds as in (توصون) below.
(توصون): it contains iʿlāl by deletion; its original form is توصيون ... the ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so it was made quiescent and the vowel transferred to the ṣād — iʿlāl by quiescence — and because of the meeting of two quiescents — the yāʾ and the wāw — the yāʾ was deleted, because it is part of a word while the wāw is a complete word; so it became توصون, its pattern تفعون with ḍamma on the tāʾ. In addition to this, there is the deletion of the hamza from its beginning for lightening, following the pattern of ينفقون (see verse 3 of Sūrat al-Baqara).
(كلالة): a noun for one who dies having no child or father; it may also be a noun for the inherited property, or the heir, or the inheriting, or kinship ... Its pattern is فعالة. It is also one of the aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdars of the verb كلّ يكلّ, of the bāb of ضرب, meaning "to be tired".
(شركاء): plural of شريك, which is a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) from شرك يشرك, of the bāb of فرح; its pattern is فعيل.
(مضار): an active participle from the quadriliteral (ضارّ); its pattern is مفاعل — with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn —; the letter before the last was only made quiescent because of the doubling, and if the assimilation were undone the kasra would appear.

* Benefits:
(ذا) is a demonstrative for the masculine singular. The demonstrative may be preceded by the hāʾ, which is a particle of alerting (tanbīh),
so one says: هذا, and it points to what is near. The kāf, which is a particle of address, may be attached to ذا — so one says: ذاك, and it points to what is far. This kāf may be attached to it together with the lām, so one says:
ذلك, and it also points to what is far; and in that case the alif of ذا is dropped.

safi-cedvel:39-39.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (ما) is an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject) «[Note: It is permissible to parse (ماذا) — as one word — as an interrogative noun serving as the mubtadaʾ, with the preposition and its genitive noun (عليهم) attached to the khabar.]»; (ذا) is a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate); (على) is a preposition and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive (majrūr), attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ذا; (لو) is a non-jussive conditional particle — a particle of impossibility for impossibility «[Note: Or it is a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being «في», i.e. «في أيمانهم».]» —; (آمنوا) is a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma …, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (بالله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آمنوا); (الواو) is a conjunction; (اليوم) is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the Name of Majesty, genitive like it; (الآخر) is a naʿt (adjective), genitive; (الواو) is a conjunction; (أنفقوا) is like آمنوا; (من) is a preposition; (ما) is a relative noun «[Note: Or a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by (من), attached to (أنفقوا), i.e.: «أنفقوا من رزق الله».]», indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (أنفقوا); (رزق) is a past verb and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) is the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (الواو) is resumptive; (كان) is a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters); (الله) is the Name of Majesty, the noun (ism) of كان, nominative; (الباء) is a preposition and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (عليما), and this last is the khabar of كان, accusative (manṣūb).
The clause «ماذا عليهم …» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا …» has no grammatical position, resumptive … and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: «لو آمنوا لم يضرهم».
The clause «أنفقوا …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آمنوا.
The clause «رزقهم الله» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the nominal or particle relative (ما).
The clause «كان الله …» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

safi-cedvel:40-40.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) is a particle resembling the verb (inna and its sisters); (الله) is the Name of Majesty, the noun (ism) of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb); (لا) is negating; (يظلم) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو»; the verb carries the meaning of «ينتقص» (to diminish), and the first object is implied (muqaddar), i.e. «أحدا» «[Note: It is permissible to keep the meaning of ẓulm (wronging) as it is, in which case مثقال is parsed as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is its description, i.e. «لا يظلم ظلما وزن ذرّة».]»; (مثقال) is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (ذرة) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الواو) is a conjunction; (إن) is a jussive conditional particle; (تك) is a defective imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the sukūn appearing on the nūn that was dropped for lightening; the noun of تكن is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «هي», i.e. the ذرة; (حسنة) is the khabar (predicate), accusative; (يضاعف) is an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «هو», and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الواو) is a conjunction; (يؤت) is an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to the verb يضاعف, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is «هو»; (من) is a preposition; (لدن) is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of genitive, attached (mutaʿalliq) to (يؤت) «[Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (أجرا) — an adjective placed before the noun it qualifies.]»; (أجرا) is a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the first object is omitted, its implied form being «فاعلها»; (عظيما) is a naʿt (adjective) of (أجرا), accusative like it.
The clause «إنّ الله …» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا يظلم …» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «إن تك …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يضاعفها» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يؤت …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يضاعفها.

* Morphology:
(مثقال): a noun for that by which something is weighed and taken as a measure, derived from ثقل. (ذرّة): a non-derived (jāmid) noun, either for a speck of dust or for a small ant; its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:41-41.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) is resumptive; (كيف) is an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «أمر الكافرين» «[Note: Ibn Hishām — and before him al-ʿUkbarī — permitted it to be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «تصنعون».]»; (إذا) is an adverb (ẓarf) of future time, stripped of the conditional sense, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached (mutaʿalliq) to «أمر» or to the implied verb that governs the ḥāl; (جئنا) is a past verb indeclinable on the sukūn …, and (نا) is the fāʿil (agent); (من كل) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جئنا); (أمّة) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (بشهيد) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جئنا). (الواو) is a conjunction — or circumstantial (ḥāliyya) —; (جئنا) is like the first; (الباء) is a preposition; (الكاف) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the second (جئنا); (على) is a preposition; (ها) is a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (أولاء) is a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (شهيدا), which is a ḥāl of the second-person pronoun in (بك), accusative (manṣūb).
The clause «كيف أمر الكافرين» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «جئنا …» is in the position of genitive as a muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «جئنا (the second) …» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the first clause جئنا «[Note: The clause may be a ḥāl, with (قد) implied.]».

* Morphology:
(جئنا): the verb contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion, owing to its being indeclinable on the sukūn; its original form is جاءنا — with sukūn on the hamza —; two sukūns met, so the alif was dropped, then the jīm was given kasra to indicate the original of the dropped letter, which is the yāʾ, because the imperfect is يجيء; its pattern is فلنا, with kasra on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:42-42.t:
* I'rab:
(يوم) is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), accusative (manṣūb), attached (mutaʿalliq) to (يود); (إذ) is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive as a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the tanwīn is a substitute for an omitted clause, i.e.: «يوم إذ جئنا …»; (يود) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); (الذين) is a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as the fāʿil (agent); (كفروا) is a past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma …, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الواو) is a conjunction; (عصوا) is like كفروا, the indeclinability being on the ḍamma implied on the alif that was dropped because two sukūns met; (الرسول) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (لو) is a maṣdar-forming particle «[Note: (لو) may be a particle of impossibility for impossibility, its apodosis being omitted, its implied form being «لسروا بذلك», and the object of يود is omitted, its implied form being «تسوية الأرض بهم», indicated by His saying: «لو تسوى بهم الأرض».]»; (تسوّى) is an imperfect verb, passive, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif; (الباء) is a preposition and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تسوى); (الأرض) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (لو تسوى بهم الأرض) is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi, governed by يود.
(الواو) is a conjunction — or resumptive —; (لا) is negating; (يكتمون) is an imperfect verb, nominative …, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الله) is the Name of Majesty, first mafʿūl bihi; (حديثا) is a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «يود الذين …» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «عصوا …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «تسوى …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (لو).
The clause «لا يكتمون …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يود «[Note: al-ʿUkbarī and Abū Ḥayyān chose that the clause be circumstantial (ḥāliyya) after the wāw of ḥāl, the possessor of the ḥāl being either the pronoun in بهم, with the governor of the ḥāl being the verb تسوى, or الذين كفروا, with the governor being the verb يود, on condition that (لو) be only a maṣdar-forming particle.]», or it is resumptive.

* Morphology:
(عصوا): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its original form is عصاوا; two sukūns met — the final radical and the wāw of the plural — so the alif — the final radical — was dropped and the letter before it kept its fatḥa to indicate it.
(تسوّى): in the reading of ʿĀṣim it is the imperfect of سوّى without deletion of the tāʾ — and in the reading of others, with shadda on the sīn, one of the two tāʾs is deleted in it — and it contains iʿlāl by conversion (qalb); its original form is تسوّي; the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into an alif.

safi-cedvel:43-43.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) is a vocative particle; (أيّ) is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative, and (ها) is a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (الذين) is a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) of أي or a naʿt (adjective) of it; (آمنوا) is a past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma …, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (لا) is the jussive prohibitive lā; (تقربوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn …, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الصلاة) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (أنتم) is a detached pronoun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject); (سكارى) is the khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (حتى) is a particle of limit and of the genitive; (تعلموا) is an imperfect verb, accusative by an «أن» concealed after حتى, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn …, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (ما) is a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi «[Note: Or a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi, i.e.: «تعلموا قولكم».]»; (تقولون) is an imperfect verb, nominative …, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and the resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تعلموا …) is in the position of genitive, attached (mutaʿalliq) to (تقربوا).
(الواو) is a conjunction; (لا) is redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation; (جنبا) is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause (أنتم سكارى), so it is also a ḥāl (circumstantial); (إلّا) is a particle of exception; (عابري) is the excepted (mustathnā), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ «[Note: (إلّا) may be in the sense of «غير», in which case it together with what follows becomes an adjective of جنب, and the effect of that appears in the word عابري … i.e. «لا تقربوا الصلاة جنبا مقيمين غير عابري سبيل».]»; (سبيل) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (حتى تغتسلوا) is like حتى تعلموا «[Note: (حتى) in the sense of «إلى» or «إلّا» …]».
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تغتسلوا) is in the position of genitive, attached to (تقربوا).
(الواو) is resumptive; (إن) is a jussive conditional particle; (كنتم) is a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters), indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) …, and (تم) is a pronoun, the noun of كان; (مرضى) is the khabar of كنتم, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif; (أو) is a conjunction; (على سفر) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted element conjoined to the khabar of كنتم; (أو) is like the first; (جاء) is a past verb; (أحد) is the fāʿil, nominative; (من) is a preposition and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt of أحد; (من الغائط) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جاء); (أو) is like the first; (لامستم) is a past verb and its fāʿil; (النساء) is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الفاء) is a conjunction; (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion (qalb) and the jussive; (تجدوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn …, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (ماء) is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الفاء) links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (تيمموا) is an imperative verb indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn …, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (صعيدا) is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative «[Note: I.e.: «اقصدوا صعيدا طيبا».]»; (طيبا) is a naʿt, accusative; (الفاء) is a conjunction of sequel (tafrīʿiyya); (امسحوا) is like تيمموا; (بوجوه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (امسحوا) «[Note: مسح is transitive by itself and by the preposition … i.e.: «مسح الوجه» and «مسح بالوجه».]», and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) is a conjunction; (أيدي) is conjoined to وجوه, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the yāʾ, and (كم) is a muḍāf ilayhi; (إنّ) is a particle resembling the verb (inna and its sisters); (الله) is the Name of Majesty, the noun of إنّ, accusative; (كان) is a defective past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو»; (عفوّا) is the khabar of كان, accusative; (غفورا) is a second khabar, accusative.
The vocative clause «يأيها الذين …» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لا تقربوا …» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative.
The clause «أنتم سكارى» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the wāw in (تقربوا).
The clause «تعلموا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «تقولون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما), nominal or particle.
The clause «تغتسلوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second particle relative (أن).
The clause «كنتم مرضى» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «جاء أحد …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «لامستم …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «لم تجدوا …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «تيمموا …» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «امسحوا …» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause تيمموا.
The clause «إنّ الله كان …» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كان عفوا …» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كان. «[Translator's note: so in the source; the khabar here is presumably that of إنّ, which would be in the position of nominative.]»

* Morphology:
(سكارى): plural of سكران, on the pattern فعلان with fatḥa on the fāʾ, a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) from سكر يسكر, of the bāb of فرح; and (سكارى) has ḍamma on the sīn, and it may take fatḥa.
(جنبا): a noun that has been treated like the maṣdar, which is الإجناب, so it is a word applied to the singular, dual and plural, masculine and feminine … Some made it a sound masculine plural, saying «قوم جنبون», and a broken plural, saying «قوم أجناب», and in its dual they said «جنبان» (see verse 191 of Sūrat Āl ʿImrān).
(عابري): plural of عابر, active participle of عبر يعبر, of the bāb of نصر; its pattern is فاعل.
(الغائط): in the form of an active participle but it is not one; its verb is غاط يغوط, of the bāb of نصر; so it is a non-derived (jāmid) noun for a place or a thing.
(صعيدا): a non-derived noun meaning earth (soil).
(عفوا): a ṣifa mushabbaha from عفا يعفو, of the bāb of نصر; its pattern is فعول; the final radical was assimilated (idghām) into the wāw of فعول.

* Rhetoric:
1- Kināya (metonymy): in His saying, the Exalted: أَوْ جاءَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ مِنَ الْغائِطِ.
Coming from it is a metonymy for ritual impurity (ḥadath), because it is customary that whoever wants it goes to it to hide his person from people's eyes; and ascribing the coming from it to one unspecified individual among those addressed, rather than to them, is to avoid stating explicitly their association with what one is shy of, or what it is unseemly to state explicitly.
2- Kināya: in His saying, the Exalted: أَوْ لامَسْتُمُ النِّساءَ.
He, glory be to Him, means «or you have had intercourse with women», except that He used touching as a metonymy for intercourse, because it is among the things that are unseemly to state explicitly, or that one is shy of.

* Benefits:
1- The wisdom of legislation: The exegetes have related the incidents that accompanied the stages of the prohibition of wine in Muslim society, and the men who were the subject of these incidents, among them ʿUmar, ʿAlī, Ḥamza and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwf; all of them point to how deeply this phenomenon had penetrated the society of the Jāhiliyya. ʿUmar continued to drink wine in Islam until, when the verse يَسْئَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْخَمْرِ وَالْمَيْسِرِ قُلْ فِيهِما إِثْمٌ كَبِيرٌ وَمَنافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ، وَإِثْمُهُما أَكْبَرُ مِنْ نَفْعِهِما was revealed, he said: "O Allah, give us a clear, satisfying explanation about wine." He continued until, when the verse يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لا تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلاةَ وَأَنْتُمْ سُكارى حَتَّى تَعْلَمُوا ما تَقُولُونَ was revealed, he said: "O Allah, give us a clear, satisfying explanation about wine," until the explicit verse of prohibition was revealed: إِنَّمَا الْخَمْرُ وَالْمَيْسِرُ وَالْأَنْصابُ وَالْأَزْلامُ رِجْسٌ مِنْ عَمَلِ الشَّيْطانِ فَاجْتَنِبُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ، إِنَّما يُرِيدُ الشَّيْطانُ أَنْ يُوقِعَ بَيْنَكُمُ الْعَداوَةَ وَالْبَغْضاءَ فِي الْخَمْرِ وَالْمَيْسِرِ، وَيَصُدَّكُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَعَنِ الصَّلاةِ، فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُنْتَهُونَ؟!. ʿUmar said: "We have desisted, we have desisted …!"

safi-cedvel:44-45.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) is for interrogation; (لم) is a particle of negation, the jussive and conversion (qalb); (تر) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «أنت»; (إلى) is a preposition; (الذين) is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached (mutaʿalliq) to (تر) by its being made to carry the meaning of «تنظر»; (أوتوا) is a past verb, passive, indeclinable on the ḍamma …, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (نصيبا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (من الكتاب) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of نصيب; (يشترون) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الضلالة) is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) is a conjunction; (يريدون) is like يشترون; (أن) is a maṣdar-forming and accusative particle; (تضلوا) is an imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn …, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (السبيل) is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو) is resumptive; (الله) is the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (أعلم) is the khabar (predicate), nominative; (بأعداء) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أعلم), and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) is a conjunction; (كفى) is a past verb indeclinable on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa; (الباء) is redundant (zāʾida); (الله) is the Name of Majesty, genitive in form, nominative in position, the fāʿil of كفى; (وليا) is a tamyīz (specification), accusative — or a ḥāl (circumstantial). (الواو) is a conjunction; (كفى بالله نصيرا) is like the preceding.
The clause «لم تر إلى …» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أوتوا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يشترون …» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «يشترون …» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the nāʾib fāʿil, and in the view of Ibn Hishām it is an explication of something implied, to which the clause يريدون is conjoined, so the meaning is: «ألم تر إلى قصة الذين أوتوا». «[Translator's note: the source repeats the line on «يشترون»; both are translated as written.]»
The clause «يريدون …» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause يشترون.
The clause «تضلوا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «الله أعلم …» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كفى بالله وليا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the last resumptive clause.
The clause «كفى بالله نصيرا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the preceding clause كفى «[Note: Ibn Hishām made these clauses parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), on condition that (من الذين هادوا …) be an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of الذين أوتوا; and the preposition may be attached to (نصيرا).]».

* Morphology:
(أعلم): this form is not intended for preference (tafḍīl) but rather for description, so أعلم means عليم or عالم.

* Benefits:
1- «لم among the grammarians»: The grammarians agree that «لم» is a particle of negation, the jussive and conversion:
a- A particle of the jussive, i.e. it puts the imperfect verb in the jussive with one of the three signs of the jussive: the sukūn, the dropping of the nūn, or the dropping of the weak letter from the end of the verb.
b- A particle of negation, meaning that the verb after it is negated and not affirmed.
c- A particle of conversion, i.e. it converts the time of the imperfect verb on which it enters from the present and future to the past.

safi-cedvel:13-13.t:
* I'rab:
(تي) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn that appears on the yāʾ which was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents, in the position of the nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address; (حدود) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الواو) resumptive; (من) a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (يطع) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he"; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunctive; (رسول) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the Name of Majesty, accusative like it, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (يدخل) an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and (الهاء) the first mafʿūl bihi; (جنّات) the second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (تجري) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, (من تحت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (الأنهار) — or to the verb (تجري) — and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الأنهار) fāʿil, nominative; (خالدين) ḥāl, accusative, of the object of (يدخل); it comes in the plural according to the meaning of the object, and it may be singular, as will come; the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ; (في) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (خالدين); (الواو) resumptive; (ذلك) like the first; (الفوز) khabar, nominative; (العظيم) a naʿt (adjective) of (الفوز), nominative like it.
The clause «تلك حدود الله» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «من يطع ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يطع الله ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: the khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «يدخله» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «تجري ... الأنهار» is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of (جنّات).
The clause «ذلك الفوز ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(الفوز): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb فاز يفوز, of the bāb of نصر; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:14-14.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive; (من يعص الله ورسوله) like (من يطع الله ورسوله) in the preceding verse, and the sign of the jussive (majzūm) for the verb (يعص) is the dropping of the weak letter; (الواو) conjunctive; (يتعدّ) an imperfect verb, jussive, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (يعص), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he"; (حدود) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (يدخله نارا خالدا فيها) like (يدخله جنّات ... خالدين فيها) in the preceding verse; (الواو) conjunctive; (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (عذاب) a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); (مهين) a naʿt (adjective) of (عذاب), nominative (marfūʿ) like it.
The clause «من يعص الله ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause (من يطع الله).
The clause «يعص الله ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: in the preceding verse (13).].
The clause «يتعدّ ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause (يعص).
The clause «يدخله» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «له عذاب ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause (يدخله) ...
or resumptive.

* Morphology:
(يعص): it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by deletion on account of the jussive; its pattern is يفع.
(يتعدّ): it contains iʿlāl by deletion on account of the jussive. Its pattern is يتفعّ with fatḥa on the doubled ʿayn, and it contains iʿlāl by conversion (qalb); its original form in the nominative state is يتعدي.

* Rhetoric:
1- The singular and the plural: in His saying, Exalted is He: «خالِدِينَ فِيها» and His saying: «خالِداً فِيها». Perhaps the preference for the singular here is in view of the outward form of the word, and the choice of the plural there is in view of the meaning, to indicate that abiding eternally in the abode of reward in the state of togetherness is more conducive to intimacy, just as abiding eternally in the abode of punishment in the state of isolation is more severe in bringing on desolation.

* Benefits:
1- In these two verses there is a rhetorical subtlety that the scholars of rhetoric seldom address, but which the scholars of tafsīr do not pass over: the description of the people of Paradise came in the first verse in the plural form «خالدين», while the description of the people of the Fire came in the second verse in the singular form «خالدا». There are two views in explaining that:
The first: that the people of Paradise have varying ranks, and therefore describing them [Translator's note: the source has the dual «وصفهما», "describing the two of them"; rendered by the evident sense.] in the plural form was required, whereas the people of the Fire do not vary in punishment — all of them are in the Fire — and therefore He described them in the singular form.
The second: some exegetes explained the difference — describing the people of Paradise in the plural and the people of the Fire in the singular — by holding that the singular for the people of the Fire is an increase in desolation and harshness in punishment, while the plural for the people of Paradise implies intimacy through togetherness and happiness through mutual acquaintance and meeting.
Both views are good, so choose from them whichever seems to you more worthy of acceptance.

safi-cedvel:15-15.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اللاتي) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يأتين) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative ... and the nūn is the fāʿil (agent); (الفاحشة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (من نساء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of (يأتين), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) because the mubtadaʾ resembles a condition; (استشهدوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (على) a preposition and (هنّ) an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive (majrūr), attached to the verb (استشهدوا); (أربعة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (منكم) like (عليهنّ), attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (أربعة), and the tamyīz (specification) of the number is omitted, its implied form being "witnesses" or "men"; (الفاء) resumptive; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (شهدوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (أمسكوا) like (استشهدوا), and (هنّ) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (في البيوت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أمسكوهنّ), (حتّى) a particle of limit and a preposition; (يتوفّى) an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed (أن), the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (هنّ) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الموت) fāʿil, nominative, with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. the angels of death.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يتوفّاهنّ الموت) is in the position of the genitive by (حتّى), attached to (أمسكوهنّ).
(أو) a conjunction; (يجعل) an imperfect verb, accusative, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (يتوفى); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (اللام) a preposition and (هنّ) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يجعل) [Note: or to an omitted ḥāl of (سبيلا), or to an omitted second object of the verb (يجعل).], (سبيلا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «اللاتي يأتين ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يأتين ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (اللاتي).
The clause «استشهدوا» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (اللاتي) [Note: the fāʾ was added in the clause because the relative resembles a condition — according to the view of the majority — or adding the fāʾ in the khabar is permitted absolutely, without restriction, according to the view of al-Akhfash.].
The clause «إن شهدوا» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أمسكوهنّ» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يتوفّاهنّ الله» [Translator's note: so in the source; the verse reads «يتوفّاهنّ الموت».] has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «يجعل الله..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause (يتوفّاهنّ).

safi-cedvel:16-16.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive; (اللذان) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the alif, in the position of the nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يأتيان) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn..
and (الألف) an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent), and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent pronoun; (الفاء) redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) [Note: the fāʾ was added in the clause because the relative resembles a condition — according to the view of the majority — or adding the fāʾ in the khabar is permitted absolutely, without restriction, according to the view of al-Akhfash.], (آذوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (هما) an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (الفاء) resumptive; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (تابا) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (الألف) the fāʿil; (الواو) conjunctive; (أصلحا) like (تابا) and conjoined to it; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (أعرضوا) an imperative verb like (آذوا); (عن) a preposition and (هما) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (أعرضوا), (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb); (كان) a defective past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "He"; (توّابا) the khabar of kāna, accusative; (رحيما) a second khabar, accusative.
The clause «اللذان يأتيانها ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause (اللاتي يأتين) in the preceding verse.
The clause «يأتيانها..» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (اللذان).
The clause «آذوهما» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (اللذان).
The clause «تابا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أصلحا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause (تابا).
The clause «أعرضوا ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إنّ الله كان..» has no grammatical position, resumptive and causal.
The clause «كان توّابا..» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.

* Benefits:
1- These two verses are abrogated by the ruling on the adulteress and the adulterer in Sūrat «al-Nūr», which is flogging and stoning. The ruling on them at the beginning of Islam was that a woman, if her adultery was established by just evidence, would be confined in a house and not leave it until she died or Allah made a way for her. The way was the abrogation.
2- In this verse two relative nouns occur, namely «اللاتي for the feminine plural, and اللذان for the masculine dual». Their spelling in the Muṣḥaf came with «a single lām», whereas they are [normally] written with «two lāms».
The spelling of words in the Muṣḥaf has been preserved and no change or alteration has touched it, out of preservation of the sanctity of the Muṣḥaf. This does not prevent us from mentioning that four of the relative nouns are written with a single lām, namely: الذي, الذين, التي and الألى, and everything other than these four is written with two lāms.
They are «اللذان and اللذين, اللتان and اللتين, اللّاتي, اللواتي and اللائي».
We do not know a reason for that; so whoever wishes, let him search the depths of the lengthy works — perhaps he will find a connection and cause for this distinction. 3- The nūn of the feminine plural is of two kinds: the light one, which is a pronoun absolutely; and the doubled one, about which there are two opinions. The first: that it is a particle indicating the feminine plural, and what precedes it is the pronoun, whether it is a hāʾ, as in «يتوفاهنّ», or the kāf, as in «يجعلكنّ». The second: that it is part of the pronoun.

safi-cedvel:17-17.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّما) the restraining particle and the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (التوبة) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. the acceptance of repentance [Note: because the maṣdar (التوبة) is the maṣdar of the verb in "تاب الله على فلان" (Allah turned in forgiveness to so-and-so).], (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, also with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e.: the grace of Allah, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of (التوبة) [Note: i.e. consequent upon the grace of Allah, not by way of obligation.. Abū Ḥayyān chose that (للذين) be attached to the "being established" (istiqrār) to which the preposition phrase (على الله) is attached, and what is given above is the choice of al-ʿUkbarī.], (اللام) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive (majrūr), attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) whose governor is the istiqrār; (يعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (السّوء) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (بجهالة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "falling into it in ignorance", or the preposition phrase is the ḥāl, i.e. "ignorant of their deed"; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (يتوبون) like (يعملون); (من قريب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يتوبون), with the omission of the qualified noun, i.e. "from a near time"; (الفاء) conjunctive; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (الكاف) for address; (يتوب) an imperfect verb, nominative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (يتوب), (الواو) resumptive; (كان الله عليما حكيما) like (كان توابا رحيما) — in the preceding verse —.
The clause «إنّما التوبة» على الله [Translator's note: the source places «على الله» outside the quotation marks; reproduced as written.] has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يعملون السوء..» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يتوبون..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أولئك يتوب الله..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يتوب الله..» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «كان الله عليما..» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(جهالة): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb جهل يجهل, of the bāb of فرح; its pattern is فعالة with fatḥa on the fāʾ; and there is another maṣdar, جهل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Benefits:
(أولاء) is a demonstrative for the plural, masculine and feminine, for rational beings and others. The demonstrative may be preceded by a hāʾ, which is the particle of alerting (tanbīh): هؤلاء الطلاب مجتهدون (these students are diligent). ها is a particle of alerting; أولاء is a demonstrative, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; الطلاب is a badal (substitute), nominative; and مجتهدون is the khabar, nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. The kāf of address may be attached to it, so one says: أولئك.

safi-cedvel:79-79.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive (ism sharṭ jāzim), indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (أصاب) a past verb, indeclinable, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من حسنة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of أصاب; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "huwa"; (الواو) conjunction; (ما أصابك ... من نفسك) like its counterpart above. (الواو) resumptive; (أرسلنا) a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn ... and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil; and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أرسلنا); (رسولا) an accusative (manṣūb) ḥāl, emphasizing the accusative pronoun; (الواو) resumptive; (كفى بالله شهيدا) its i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse (70) of this surah.
(2, 3) The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.] .
The clause «ما أصابك ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أصابك من حسنة» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ما) «2» .
The clause «(هو) من الله» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of a jussive condition, joined with al-fāʾ.
The clause «ما أصابك» (the second) has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «أصابك من سيئة» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (ما) «3» .
The clause «(هو) من نفسك» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with al-fāʾ.
The clause «أرسلناك ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كفى بالله ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Rhetoric:
1- In this verse Allah presented the explanation from His own side by way of varying the address (talwīn al-khiṭāb); and the iltifāt (shift of address) signals greater attention to it and concern to refute their false belief and corrupt claim, and indicates that its content is built on a subtle wisdom worthy of being explained by the Knower of the unseen, Mighty and Majestic. [Translator's note: the source prints «علام الغيوم» ("the clouds"), evidently a misprint for «علام الغيوب» ("the unseen"), which is translated here.]
2- Al-majāz al-mursal (metonymic trope): in attributing the evil deed to the servant; the relation is causality, because it is the self that ruins its owner and entangles him in committing sins.

* Benefits:
- The saying of Allah the Exalted: ما أَصابَكَ مِنْ حَسَنَةٍ فَمِنَ اللَّهِ وَما أَصابَكَ مِنْ سَيِّئَةٍ فَمِنْ نَفْسِكَ. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, attributed the good to Himself because He wills good and happiness for His servants, and attributed the evil to man because He forbade man from doing evil deeds, so the evil comes about because man commits it. There is no contradiction in this with His saying: كُلٌّ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ, because everything that happens in the universe happens by the will of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, even though He does not will evil for His servants.

safi-cedvel:80-80.t:
* I'rab:
(من) a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يطع) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), given a kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (الرسول) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (أطاع) a past verb; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi; (الواو) conjunction; (من) like the first من; (تولّى) a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, in the position of jussive as the protasis; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (ما) negative; (أرسلناك) its i'rab was given in the previous verse; (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (حفيظا) on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. حفيظا على أعمالهم ("a guardian over their deeds"); (حفيظا) ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object pronoun in (أرسلناك), accusative.
The clause «من يطع ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يطع الرسول» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of the first mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.] .
The clause «قد أطاع ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with al-fāʾ.
The clause «من تولى ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause من يطع ...
The clause «تولى ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.] , and the second apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "لا تحزن" ("do not grieve") or "لا يهمنّك" ("let it not trouble you").
The clause «ما أرسلناك ...» has no grammatical position, giving the reason for the implied apodosis.

* Morphology:
(يطع): it contains iʿlāl (phonological change) by deletion owing to the jussive; its origin is يطيع; two quiescent letters met, the yāʾ and the ʿayn, so the yāʾ was deleted; its pattern is يفل, with ḍamma on the yāʾ and kasra on the fāʾ.
(أطاع): it contains iʿlāl by conversion; its origin is أطوع with a fatḥa on the wāw; then the vowel was transferred to the ṭāʾ and the wāw was converted into an alif.
(حفيظا) an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from حفظ يحفظ, of the class of فرح; its pattern is فعيل.

safi-cedvel:81-81.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (يقولون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (طاعة) khabar (predicate) of a mubtadaʾ (subject) necessarily omitted, its implied form being "أمرنا" ("our matter") [Note: Or a postponed mubtadaʾ, with the khabar omitted, its implied form being منّا, i.e.: منّا طاعة ("from us is obedience").] , (الفاء) conjunction; (إذا) an adverb for the future containing the sense of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis بيّت; (برزوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (من عند) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (برزوا); and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (بيّت) a past verb; (طائفة) fāʿil, nominative; (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of طائفة; (غير) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (تقول) an imperfect verb, nominative; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "anta"; (الواو) parenthetical; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (يكتب) an imperfect verb, nominative; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi [Note: It may be a maṣdar-forming particle, or an indefinite noun qualified, with the clause after it as its naʿt.] , and the referring pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted; (يبيّتون) like يقولون; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; (أعرض) an imperative verb; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anta"; (عنهم) like منهم, attached to (أعرض); (الواو) conjunction; (توكّل) like أعرض; (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (توكل); (الواو) resumptive; (كفى بالله وكيلا) like كفى بالله عليما [Note: in verse (70) of this surah.] .
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «(أمرنا) طاعة» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «برزوا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «بيّت طائفة ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «تقول» has no grammatical position, ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «الله يكتب ...» has no grammatical position, parenthetical.
The clause «يكتب ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «يبيتون» has no grammatical position, ṣila of (ما), whether nominal or particle.
The clause «أعرض عنهم» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: إن فعلوا ذلك فأعرض عنهم ("if they do that, then turn away from them").
The clause «توكّل على الله» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause of the implied apodosis.
The clause «كفى بالله وكيلا» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(طاعة): a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the four-letter verb أطاع; its pattern is فعلة ... As for the regular maṣdar (verbal noun), it is إطاعة, of the pattern إفعلة, the tāʾ being a compensation for the alif deleted before the final letter, since there is an alif as the ʿayn of the word. It also contains iʿlāl (phonological change) by conversion; its origin is طوعة, with a fatḥa on the wāw; the wāw was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into an alif.

* Rhetoric:
Using the overt noun where a pronoun would be expected (al-iẓhār fī maqām al-iḍmār): in the saying of Allah the Exalted وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ.
The Name of Majesty is made overt where a pronoun would be expected to indicate the reason for the ruling.

* Benefits:
1- The saying of Allah the Exalted: بَيَّتَ طائِفَةٌ — the verb is masculine because طائفة is a non-real (figurative) feminine ...
Here is a summary of the cases in which the verb must be, and may be, feminine.
a- The verb must be feminine in two cases:
The first: when the agent is a real feminine not separated from the verb by anything, as in «جاءت فاطمة» .
The second: when the agent comes first, whether it is a real or a figurative feminine; the real, as in: فاطمة جاءت, and the figurative, as in: الشمس طلعت.
b- The verb may be either feminine or masculine in the following cases:
First- when the agent is a real feminine separated from the verb by something, as in: جاءت اليوم هند or جاء اليوم هند.
Second- when the agent is a figurative feminine, as in جاءت فرقة or جاء فرقة.
Third, when the agent is a broken plural, as in: جاءت الجنود or جاء الجنود.

safi-cedvel:46-46.t:
* I'rab:
(من الذين) is like إلى الذين «1», attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) «[Note: Or a khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being «هم», in which case the clause يحرفون becomes in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of هادوا.]» of an implied (muqaddar) mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «قوم»; (هادوا) is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma …, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (يحرفون) is like يشترون «3»; (الكلم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (عن مواضع) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يحرفون), and (الهاء) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) is a conjunction; (يقولون) is like يشترون; (سمعنا) is a past verb indeclinable on the sukūn …, and (نا) is a pronoun, the fāʿil; (الواو) is a conjunction; (عصينا) is like سمعنا; (الواو) is a conjunction; (اسمع) is an imperative verb of supplication, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «أنت»; (غير) is a ḥāl, accusative, of the fāʿil of اسمع; (مسمع) is a muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) «[Note: This speech is a double-edged (muwajjah) supplication: outwardly it is a supplication for him and inwardly a supplication against him … Outwardly: hear, without being made to hear anything disagreeable; and inwardly: hear, without being made to hear anything good, or: may you not hear — they supplicated against him with death or with deafness.]»; (الواو) is a conjunction; (راع) is an imperative verb of supplication, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and (نا) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is «أنت»; (ليا) is a ḥāl, accusative, by interpretation as a derived word, i.e. «لاوين ألسنتهم»; (بألسنة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the maṣdar (ليا), and (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as a muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) is a conjunction; (طعنا) is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (ليّا), accusative like it «[Note: al-Zamakhsharī permitted the accusative of (ليّا) as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and likewise (طعنا).]»; (في الدين) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (طعنا). (الواو) is resumptive; (لو) is a non-jussive conditional; (أنّ) is a particle resembling the verb (inna and its sisters), for emphasis, and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of أنّ; (قالوا) is like هادوا; (سمعنا وأطعنا واسمع) is like سمعنا وعصينا واسمع; (الواو) is a conjunction; (انظر) is an imperative verb of supplication, and (نا) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «أنت»; (اللام) occurs in the apodosis of لو; (كان) is a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters), and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «هو», referring to this divine direction; (خيرا) is the khabar of كان, accusative; (اللام) is a preposition and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (خيرا); (أقوم) is conjoined to (خيرا) by the conjunction wāw, accusative like it, and it is prevented from tanwīn because it is an adjective on the pattern أفعل.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنهم قالوا …) is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being «ثبت», i.e.: «لو ثبت قولهم» …
(الواو) is a conjunction; (لكن) is a particle of rectification (istidrāk); (لعن) is a past verb and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الله) is the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (بكفر) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (لعن), and the bāʾ is causal, and (هم) is a muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) is causal (taʿlīliyya); (لا) is negating; (يؤمنون) is an imperfect verb, nominative …, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (إلّا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (قليلا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, since it is its description «[Note: Some construed the speech as an exception, so (قليلا) is excepted from the wāw in يؤمنون; ولن «[Translator's note: so in the source; presumably «ولكن» (but)]» the preferable course in this kind of exception is to follow as a badal (substitute), i.e. with the nominative of the word قليل.]», i.e.: «لا يؤمنون إلا إيمانا قليلا».
The nominal clause «من الذين … قوم» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «هادوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يحرّفون» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of the mubtadaʾ قوم.
The clause «يقولون …» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يحرفون.
The clause «سمعنا …» is in the position of accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «عصينا» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
The clause «اسمع» (the first) is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
The clause «راعنا» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
The clause «ثبت قولهم» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «سمعنا» (the second) is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «أطعنا» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause سمعنا.
The clause «اسمع» (the second) is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause سمعنا.
The clause «انظرنا» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause سمعنا.
The clause «كان خيرا لهم» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition (لو).
The clause «لعنهم الله …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause (ثبت) قولهم.
The clause «لا يؤمنون …» has no grammatical position, causal.

* Morphology:
(الكلم): plural of الكلام, which is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the quadriliteral verb كلّم; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ, and الكلم has the pattern فعل with fatḥa then kasra.
(مواضعه): plural of موضع, which is a noun of place from the verb وضع يضع; its pattern is مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn, because the verb is weak, mithāl (first-radical weak), its fāʾ being dropped in the imperfect.
(مسمع): passive participle of the quadriliteral verb أسمع; its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(ليّا): an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb لوى, weak, lafīf maqrūn (with adjacent weak letters); the word contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion: the wāw and yāʾ came together in the word with the first of them vowelless, so the wāw was converted into a yāʾ and assimilated into the second yāʾ; its original form is لوى with fatḥa on the lām and sukūn on the wāw.
(طعنا): an aural maṣdar of the verb طعن يطعن, of the bāb of فتح; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(أقوم): a derived adjective on the pattern أفعل; it is a noun of preference (ism tafḍīl) from قام يقوم.

* Rhetoric:
Ambiguity, or double-edged speech: in His saying, the Exalted: اسْمَعْ غَيْرَ مُسْمَعٍ.
It is speech with two faces — admitting evil and good — and in badīʿ it is called tawjīh. Its admitting evil is by taking it in the sense of: hear, supplicated against that you may not hear; or: hear, without being answered in what you call to. Its admitting good is by taking it in the sense of: (hear) from us (without being made to hear) anything disagreeable — from their saying «أسمعه فلان» when someone insults him. They — may Allah the Exalted curse them — used to address the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with that in mockery, displaying to him ﷺ the latter meaning while concealing something else.
«وَراعِنا» is likewise speech with two faces like the previous one: its admitting good is in the sense of "give us respite and look at us", or "wait for us so that we may speak to you", and its admitting evil is by taking it as an insult.

* Benefits:
1- The Jews and the distortion of words from their places:
The crookedness of the Jews and their ill manners with Allah, Mighty and Majestic, reached the point that they distorted the words of the Torah from what was intended by them. Most likely this means their interpreting expressions of the Torah otherwise than what was intended by them, so as to negate what is in it of proofs of the message of Islam, and of rulings and legislation that the Qurʾān confirms, whose unity in the two scriptures indicates the unity of the source, which is Allah the Exalted, and consequently the truth of the message of the Prophet ﷺ. Distorting words from what was intended by them, to suit desires, is a phenomenon observable among the men of any religion who try to deviate from their religion and take it as a trade and a craft. Perhaps the Jews are the most skilful known for this distortion.

safi-cedvel:47-47.t:
* I'rab:
(يأيها الذين): its i'rab has already been given «[Note: In verse (43) of this sūra.]»; (أوتوا) is a past verb, passive, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma …, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (الكتاب) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (آمنوا) is an imperative verb indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn …, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الباء) is a preposition; (ما) is a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached (mutaʿalliq) to (آمنوا); (نزّلنا) is a past verb and its fāʿil; (مصدّقا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of the resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid); (اللام) is a preposition; (ما) is a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (مصدّقا) «[Note: Or اللازم «[Translator's note: so in the source; presumably «اللام» (the lām)]» is redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening, and the relative noun is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of the active participle (مصدّقا).]»; (مع) is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (من قبل) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آمنوا); (أن) is a maṣdar-forming and accusative particle; (نطمس) is an imperfect verb, accusative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «نحن», for majesty; (وجوها) is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نطمس …) is in the position of genitive by قبل being annexed to it.
(الفاء) is a conjunction; (نرد) is an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to the verb نطمس, and (ها) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is «نحن»; (على أدبار) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نرد), and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أو) is a conjunction; (نلعنهم) is like نردها; (الكاف) is a preposition «[Note: Or a noun meaning «مثل», in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is its description.]»; (ما) is a maṣdar-forming particle; (لعنّا) is like نزّلنا; (أصحاب) is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (السبت) is a muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما لعنّا …) is in the position of genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. «نلعنهم لعنا كلعن أصحاب السبت».
(الواو) is resumptive; (كان) is a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters); (أمر) is the noun of كان, nominative (marfūʿ); (الله) is the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (مفعولا) is the khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative.
The clause «يأيها الذين …» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أوتوا الكتاب …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «آمنوا …» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative.
The clause «نزّلنا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما).
