Instead of wasting the soul in sighs over the disparity, and instead of the envy and rancour that accompany that, and the bad opinion of Allah and of the justice of the distribution that arises from it — where lies the crushing blow that takes away the soul's tranquillity and bequeaths misery and anxiety — instead of all that, one should turn with one's request to Allah, and with effort and the use of legitimate means to reach what one seeks ... !

safi-cedvel:33-33.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لكل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جعلنا), which is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, (ونا) the fāʿil (agent); (موالي) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (من) a preposition; (ما) a relative, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive (majrūr), attached to an omitted verb explained by the word (موالي), i.e.: "they inherit" [Note: it is good here to mention the different interpretations in the explanation of this verse and its i'rab ... (كل), with tanwīn, is annexed to an implied [noun] meaning "every person"; so the pronoun in (ترك) — pausing on it — refers back to "every person", and (مما) is attached to the verbal meaning in the word (موالي), or to an implied [verb] explained by the sense, i.e. "they inherit from what he left" ... and (الوالدان) is nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "they are the parents and the nearest relatives" ... Or the meaning is: "for every people whom We have made heirs there is a share of what the parents and nearest relatives left", so the clause (جعلناهم) is a naʿt (adjective) of (كل), the object pronoun in the clause is omitted, and (موالي) is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) ... And there are other interpretations, making the implied [noun] "property", i.e.: "and for every property ..." etc. What we have set down above is the clearest of the i'rab analyses.], (ترك) a past verb; (الوالدان) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the alif; (الواو) conjunctive; (الأقربون) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (الوالدان), nominative like it, the sign of the nominative being the wāw. (الواو) conjunctive or resumptive; (الذين) a relative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ [Note: or conjoined to (الوالدان والأقربون), in the position of the nominative ... and the pronoun in (فآتوهم) refers back to the heirs (الموالي).], (عقدت) a past verb ...
(والتاء) is for the feminine; (أيمان) fāʿil, nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) redundant (zāʾida), entering the khabar because the relative noun resembles a condition; (آتوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi; (نصيب) the second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (إنّ الله كان على كل شيء شهيدا) the i'rab of its counterpart has passed — verse (29) —.
The clause «جعلنا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ترك الوالدان ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «الذين عقدت أيمانكم (the nominal one)» has no grammatical position, resumptive or conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «عقدت أيمانكم» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «آتوهم نصيبهم» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «إنّ الله كان ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كان ... شهيدا» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.

safi-cedvel:34-34.t:
* I'rab:
(الرجال) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (قوامون) khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (على النساء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar; (الباء) a preposition and (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (فضّل) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (بعض) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (على بعض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (فضل).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما فضل الله) is in the position of the genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, also attached to the khabar.
(الواو) conjunctive; (بما) like the first in i'rab and attachment [Note: (ما) may be a relative in the position of the genitive, with the referring pronoun omitted, i.e. "by what they spent".], (أنفقوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (من أموال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنفقوا) [Note: or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the accusative pronoun — if (ما) is parsed as a relative noun.], and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أنفقوا) is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the first interpreted maṣdar.
(الفاء) resumptive; (الصالحات) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (قانتات) khabar, nominative; (حافظات) a second khabar, nominative; (اللام) the lām of strengthening (taqwiya), redundant (zāʾida) [Note: the preposition may be a genuine one, so the preposition phrase is attached to (حافظات).], (الغيب) genitive in form, accusative in position, the mafʿūl bihi of the active participle (حافظات); (الباء) a preposition and (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: it may be a relative or a qualified indefinite noun, both in the position of the genitive, with the referring pronoun omitted.], (حفظ) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما حفظ الله) is in the position of the genitive, attached to (حافظات) or to (قانتات) ... i.e. they are so because of Allah's guarding of them by forbidding them from disobedience.
(الواو) conjunctive; (اللاتي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (تخافون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (نشوز) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هن) an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) redundant in the khabar [Note: the addition is regular (muṭṭarida [Translator's note: the source prints «مضطردة», evidently for «مطّردة».]) in the khabar according to al-Akhfash, or it is because the mubtadaʾ resembles a condition according to others.], (عظوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (هنّ) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الواو) conjunctive; (اهجروهنّ) like (عظوهن); (في المضاجع) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اهجروهنّ), (الواو) conjunctive; (اضربوهن) like (عظوهن). (الفاء) resumptive; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (أطعن) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (النون) an agent pronoun, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā; (تبغوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (على) a preposition and (هنّ) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (تبغوا) [Note: this attachment is on the interpretation of (تبغوا) as meaning "seek"; but on the meaning "wrong", the preposition is attached to an omitted ḥāl of (سبيلا) — an adjective that has preceded the qualified noun.] (سبيلا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: or accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), on the meaning "wrong", i.e.: "do not wrong them in any way".], (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the noun of inna, accusative; (كان) a defective past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "He"; (عليا) the khabar of kāna, accusative; (كبيرا) a second khabar, accusative.
The clause «الرجال قوّامون ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «فضل الله ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «أنفقوا» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second particle-relative (ما).
The clause «الصالحات قانتات» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «حفظ الله» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the third particle-relative (ما).
The clause «اللاتي تخافون ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause (الرجال ...).
The clause «تخافون ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (اللاتي).
The clause «عظوهنّ» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (اللاتي).
The clause «اهجروهنّ ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause (عظوهن).
The clause «اضربوهن» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause (عظوهن).
The clause «أطعنكم» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا تبغوا ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إنّ الله كان ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كان عليّا ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.

* Morphology:
(قوّامون): plural of قوّام, an intensive form (ṣīghat mubālagha) of the active participle, an adjective. (حافظات): plural of حافظة, the feminine of حافظ, an active participle from حفظ يحفظ, of the bāb of فرح; its pattern is فاعل.
(نشوز): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb نشزت المرأة تنشز, of the bāb of نصر and the bāb of ضرب, [used] with بزوجها, منه and عليه.. its pattern is فعول with ḍamma on the fāʾ and the ʿayn [Translator's note: the source writes the pattern as «فعلول»; the word نشوز is on the pattern فعول.].
(عظوهنّ): it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by deletion, for it is a verb with a weak first radical (mithāl); its fāʾ is dropped in the imperfect and the imperative if the ʿayn of the verb in the imperfect has kasra. Its pattern is علوهنّ with kasra on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
Metonymy (kināya): in His saying, Exalted is He: وَاهْجُرُوهُنَّ فِي الْمَضاجِعِ.
The expression is a metonymy for abstaining from intercourse with them.

* Benefits:
2- The man's guardianship (qiwāma) over the family:
Allah has made "pairing" part of the nature of the human being, as with every living thing: وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ. Then He willed to make the pair in the human being two halves of a single soul: يا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ واحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْها زَوْجَها.
And by the meeting of the two halves of the single soul He willed, among what He willed, that this meeting be a repose for the soul and tranquillity for the spirit, then a covering and protection, a field for offspring, and a continuation and elevation of life: وَمِنْ آياتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَزْواجاً لِتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْها وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ مَوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً.
And since this family must have a leader and someone in charge of it, the Quran has assigned the guardianship to the man, taking into account in that the natural disposition and the endowed aptitudes of each of the two halves of the soul for performing the functions entrusted to each of them, and taking into account justice in the distribution of burdens.
3- The distribution of the family's tasks:
Allah singled out the woman with tenderness, affection, quickness of emotion and swift response to the demands of childhood — characteristics that are not superficial but deeply rooted in the woman's organic constitution — and He equipped the man with toughness, firmness, slowness of emotion, and the use of awareness and thought.
So the woman, with her characteristics, was fit for the upbringing of children and their rearing, which is a sublime and momentous task.
And the man, with his characteristics, was fit for managing the affairs of livelihood, spending on the family, protecting it and having guardianship over it.
The making of Allah, who perfected everything — so exalted is Allah, the best of creators.

safi-cedvel:97-100.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ; (توفى) an imperfect verb, nominative [Note: The verb may be a past verb; the tāʾ of the feminine was not attached to it because the verb is separated from the agent by the object.] , the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, the tāʾ having been deleted for lightness; and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الملائكة) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (ظالمي) an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object pronoun, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (أنفس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (قالوا) a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (في) a preposition; (ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the fronted khabar (predicate) of كنتم; the alif has been deleted from the noun; (كنتم) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on sukūn ... and (تم) a pronoun, the noun of كان; (قالوا) like the first; (كنّا) like كنتم; (مستضعفين) the khabar of كنا, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar; (قالوا) like the first; (الهمزة) for disapproving interrogation; (لم) a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and the jussive; (تكن) an incomplete imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); (أرض) the noun of تكن, nominative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (واسعة) the khabar of تكن, accusative; (الفاء) the fāʾ of causation; (تهاجروا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya), the sign of the subjunctive being the deletion of the nūn [Note: The verb may be conjoined by al-fāʾ to the jussive imperfect (تكن), and so be jussive like it; this is the preference of Abū Ḥayyān.] ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (في) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تهاجروا), by making it include the sense of تسيحوا ("travel") or تنتقلوا ("move").
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تهاجروا) is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: أليس ثمة اتساع في الأرض فهجرة منكم ("Was there not spaciousness in the earth, and so emigration on your part?").
(الفاء) redundant (zāʾida), because it occurs in the khabar and because the mubtadaʾ resembles a condition; (أولئك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) ... and (الكاف) for address; (مأوى) a second mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma on the alif, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (جهنم) the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الواو) resumptive; (ساءت) an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame ... and (التاء) for the feminine, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "hiya"; (مصيرا) tamyīz (specification), accusative ... and the specified object of blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "hiya", i.e. Jahannam.
The clause «إنّ الذين توفاهم الملائكة ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «توفاهم الملائكة» has no grammatical position, ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «قالوا ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of الملائكة, with قد understood.
The clause «كنتم ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «قالوا (the second) ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «كنا مستضعفين» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «قالوا (the third)» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تكن أرض ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
The clause «تهاجروا ...» has no grammatical position, ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «أولئك مأواهم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of (إن).
The clause «مأواهم جهنم» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «ساءت مصيرا» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
(98) (إلا) a particle of exception; (المستضعفين) accusative as a connected exception (istithnāʾ muttaṣil) from الذين توفاهم ... or a disconnected exception from those who disobeyed by staying behind from the emigration, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (من الرجال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of المستضعفين; (الواو) conjunction in both places; (النساء، والولدان) two nouns conjoined to الرجال by the two conjunctions, genitive like it; (لا) negative; (يستطيعون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (حيلة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (لا يهتدون) like لا يستطيعون; (سبيلا) accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), the original being إلى سبيل [Note: Or it is a mafʿūl bihi, by making (يهتدون) include the sense of يعرفون, i.e.: they do not know a way to the emigration.] .
The clause «لا يستطيعون ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption [Note: It may be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.] .
The clause «لا يهتدون ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا يستطيعون.
(99) (الفاء) resumptive; (أولئك) like the first; (عسى) an inflexible, incomplete past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of عسى; (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle; (يعفو) an imperfect verb, subjunctive by أن; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (عن) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يعفو).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يعفو) is in the position of accusative as the khabar of عسى.
(الواو) resumptive; (كان الله عفوّا غفورا) the i'rab of its counterpart has already been given [Note: in verse (96) of this surah.] .
The clause «أولئك عسى ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «عسى الله ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «يعفو» has no grammatical position, ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «كان الله عفوا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
(100) (الواو) resumptive; (من) a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (يهاجر) an imperfect verb, jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", referring to the conditional noun; (في سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يهاجر) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl of the agent of يهاجر, i.e. striving in the way of Allah.] , (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; (يجد) an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يجد); (مراغما) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (كثيرا) naʿt (adjective), accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (سعة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (مراغما), accusative like it; (الواو) conjunction; (من يخرج) like من يهاجر; (من بيت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يخرج), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (مهاجرا) an accusative ḥāl; (إلى الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (مهاجرا); (الواو) conjunction; (رسول) maʿṭūf to the Name of Majesty, genitive like it, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (ثم) a conjunction; (يدرك) an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to (يخرج), and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الموت) fāʿil, nominative; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (وقع) a past verb; (أجر) fāʿil, nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (وقع); (الواو) resumptive; (كان الله غفورا رحيما) the i'rab of its counterpart has already been given [Note: in verse (96) of this surah.
(3, 4) The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.] .
The clause «من يهاجر ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يهاجر ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «3» .
The clause «يجد ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis not joined with al-fāʾ.
The clause «من يخرج ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause من يهاجر.
The clause «يخرج ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (من) «4» .
The clause «يدركه الموت» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يخرج.
The clause «قد وقع أجره ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with al-fāʾ.
The clause «كان الله غفورا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(مستضعفين): the plural of مستضعف, a passive participle from the six-letter استضعف; its pattern is مستفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(75) (حيلة) an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb حال يحول in the sense of احتال ("to devise a stratagem"); its pattern is فعلة, with kasra then sukūn. It contains iʿlāl (phonological change) by conversion; its origin is حولة; the wāw came quiescent after a kasra, so it was converted into a yāʾ.
(مراغما): a noun of place from the four-letter راغم [Note: راغم comes in the sense of "to be angry with and be hostile to", and in the sense of "to leave him in spite of him".] , so it is on the pattern of the passive participle; its pattern is مفاعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(مهاجرا): an active participle from the four-letter هاجر; its pattern is مفاعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

* Benefits:
1- The saying of Allah the Exalted ظالِمِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ — the original is ظالمين أنفسهم, but the nūn was deleted from the sound masculine plural because it is in annexation (muḍāf). This is a consistent rule: the nūn is deleted from the dual and the sound masculine plural when annexed, by analogy with the deletion of the tanwīn from the singular noun on annexation. Hence their statement, in parsing the nūn of the dual and of the sound masculine plural, that it is a compensation for the tanwīn in the singular noun. So reflect.
2- The saying of Allah the Exalted: عَسَى اللَّهُ أَنْ يَعْفُوَ عَنْهُمْ. «عسى» is one of the verbs of hope, and like it are حرى and اخلولق. They are followed by the verbs of approximation, which indicate the nearness of the occurrence of the khabar, namely «كاد، كرب، أوشك», and likewise the verbs of commencement, such as: شرع - طفق - انشأ - أخذ - بدأ - جعل. These three groups are regarded as incomplete verbs that operate like «kāna and its sisters», except that their khabar comes as a verbal clause whose verb is imperfect, joined with «أن» with «حرى واخلولق». Joining it with «أن» is not permitted with the verbs of commencement, because these verbs indicate the past while «أن» conveys the future. As for the rest of the verbs mentioned, their khabar may be joined with «أن», and it may also not be joined with it.

safi-cedvel:176-176.t:
* I'rab:
(يستفتون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "anta" (you) (الله) the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (يفتي) imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (في الكلالة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يفتيكم), (إن) conditional particle governing the jussive (امرؤ) fāʿil of an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned after it, i.e. «إن هلك امرؤ» (if a man perishes) (هلك) past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (ليس) defective (nāqiṣ), inflexible (jāmid) past verb (اللام) preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to the khabar (predicate) of ليس (ولد) noun of ليس, nominative (الواو) conjunction (له) like the first, attached to a fronted khabar (أخت) postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) (لها) like له, attached to a fronted khabar (نصف) postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative (ما) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) (ترك) like هلك, and the pronoun of the fāʿil refers to the one who perished (الواو) resumptive (هو) detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (يرث) like يفتي, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (إن) like the first (لم) and [Translator's note: so in the source, with a stray «و»] particle of negation (يكن) defective imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) [Note: or it is complete (tāmm), and the prepositional phrase (له) is attached to it, or is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (ولد), which is the fāʿil of يكن.], (لها) like له, attached to the khabar of يكن (ولد) noun of يكن, nominative, (الفاء) conjunction (إن) like the first (كانتا) defective past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive as the protasis.. and (الألف) is the noun of كان (اثنتين) khabar of كان, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ (الفاء) linking the apodosis (لهما الثلثان) like لها النصف (من) preposition (ما) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to a ḥāl of (الثلثان), (ترك) like هلك (الواو) conjunction (إن كانوا إخوة) like إن كانتا اثنتين (رجالا) badal (substitute) of إخوة (الواو) conjunction (نساء) conjoined to رجال, accusative like it (الفاء) linking the apodosis (للذكر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar (مثل) mubtadaʾ, nominative — and it is originally a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. «حظّ مثل حظّ الأنثيين» (a share like the share of two females) — (حظّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) (الأنثيين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ [Note: see the i'rab of the counterpart of this verse in verse (11) of this surah.], (يبيّن) like يفتي (الله) the Divine Name, fāʿil, nominative (لكم) like له, attached to (يبيّن), (أن) maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle (تضلّوا) imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تضلّوا) is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), on the basis of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. «خشية أن تضلّوا» (for fear that you go astray) [Note: the i'rab of the verse may be accounted for by the omission of the negating (لا) after أن, i.e.: «لئلّا تضلّوا» (so that you do not go astray); the interpreted maṣdar is then in the position of genitive by the implied lām, attached to (يبيّن).].
(الواو) resumptive (الله) the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ, nominative (بكل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عليم), (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (عليم) khabar of the mubtadaʾ الله.
The clause «يستفتونك ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «قل ...»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «الله يفتيكم ...»: in the position of accusative, the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يفتيكم ...»: in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «إن (هلك) امرؤ»: has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
The clause «هلك (the overt one)»: has no grammatical position, explicative.
The clause «ليس له ولد»: in the position of nominative, a naʿt of (امرؤ).
The clause «له أخت»: in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause ليس له ولد.
The clause «لها نصف ...»: in the position of jussive, the apodosis of the jussive-governing condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ترك»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «هو يرثها»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إن (هلك) امرؤ [Note: the clause may be resumptive in origin.].
The clause «يرثها»: in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هو).
The clause «يكن لها ولد»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.. and the apodosis
is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. «فهو يرثها» (then he inherits from her).
The clause «كانتا اثنتين»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إن لم يكن....
The clause «لهما الثلثان»: in the position of jussive, the apodosis of the jussive-governing condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ترك (the second)»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative noun (ما).
The clause «كانوا أخوة»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إن كانتا اثنتين [Note: or it is resumptive.].
The clause «للذكر مثل حظّ ...»: in the position of jussive, the apodosis of the jussive-governing condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يبيّن الله ...»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أن تضلّوا»: has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «الله ... عليم»: has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(يستفتونك): it contains a weak-letter change by deletion (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf); its original form is يستفتيونك, with ḍamma on the second yāʾ; then its vowel was transferred to the tāʾ before it, and then it was deleted because it met, quiescent, with the wāw of the agent.. Its pattern is يستفعونك. [Translator's note: the source prints the original form as «يستفتينوك», evidently a misprint for «يستفتيونك».]

safi-cedvel:72-73.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is resumptive; (إنّ) is a particle resembling the verb (inna and its sisters); (من) is a preposition and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached (mutaʿalliq) to a fronted khabar (predicate); (اللام) is a particle of emphasis; (من) is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the delayed noun of إنّ; (اللام) is the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (يبطئن) is an imperfect verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative because it is free of any accusative or jussive governor …, and the nūn is for emphasis, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو»; (الفاء) is a conjunction; (إن) is a jussive conditional particle; (أصابت) is a past verb …, and (التاء) is for the feminine, and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (مصيبة) is the fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (قال) is a past verb, indeclinable, in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «هو», referring to من; (قد) is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (أنعم) is a past verb; (الله) is the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (على) is a preposition and (الياء) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أنعم); (إذ) is an adverb, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to (أنعم); (لم) is a particle of negation and the jussive; (أكن) is a defective imperfect verb (kāna and its sisters), jussive (majzūm), and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «أنا»; (مع) is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), accusative (manṣūb), attached to the khabar, and (هم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (شهيدا) is the khabar of أكن, accusative.
The clause «إنّ منكم لمن …» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The implied oath clause together with its answer has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «يبطئنّ» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the implied oath.
The clause «أصابتكم مصيبة» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «قال …» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «قد أنعم الله …» is in the position of accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لم أكن معهم شهيدا» is in the position of genitive by (إذ) being annexed to it.
(73) (الواو) is a conjunction; (اللام) paves the way for the oath (mūṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); (إن) is a jussive conditional particle; (أصابكم فضل) is like أصابتكم مصيبة; (من الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of فضل; (ليقولنّ) is like ليبطئن; (كأن) is a lightened particle resembling the verb, and its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); (لم تكن) is like لم أكن, and its noun will come; (بين) is an adverb of place, accusative, attached to the omitted, fronted khabar of تكن, and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) is a conjunction; (بينه) is like بينكم; (مودّة) is the delayed noun of تكن, nominative; (يا) is a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ليت) is a particle resembling the verb, for wishing, and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) is a pronoun, the noun of ليت, in the position of accusative; (كنت) is a defective past verb indeclinable on the sukūn …, and (التاء) is the noun of كان; (معهم) is like the first, attached to the khabar of كان; (الفاء) is the fāʾ of causation (sababiyya); (أفوز) is an imperfect verb, accusative by an «أن» concealed after the fāʾ, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «أنا»; (فوزا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative; (عظيما) is a naʿt, accusative.
The clause «إن أصابكم فضل» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause in the previous verse.
The clause «يقولنّ …» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the implied oath, and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath.
The clause «كأن لم تكن …» has no grammatical position, parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya) «[Note: It may be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent pronoun in (يقولنّ), and that is the choice of al-ʿUkbarī.]».
The clause «لم تكن … مودّة» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of كأن.
The clause «ليتني كنت …» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl of the verb يقولن.
The clause «كنت معهم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of ليت.
The clause «أفوز» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the concealed particle relative (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أفوز) is conjoined by the fāʾ to a maṣdar gleaned from the preceding speech, the implied form being: «there is a wish for my being with them, and so a great triumph for me».

* Morphology:
(مودة): a mīmī maṣdar from the verb ودّ يودّ, of the bāb of فتح; its pattern is مفعلة, and the tāʾ is added for intensity, not for the feminine. Or it is an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb; the verb has many other aural maṣdars, namely: ودّ with fatḥa, ḍamma and kasra on the wāw; وداد with fatḥa, kasra and ḍamma on the wāw; ودادة with fatḥa on the wāw; موددة with lightening; and مودودة.

* Benefits:
1- «كَأَنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ».
«كأن» is lightened from the heavy «كأنّ», and the grammarians have said about it:
If its khabar is a clause with a fully inflecting verb, the two are separated by «قد», as in «كأن قد ألمّ به مصيبة».
If its khabar is a negated clause, the two are separated by «لم», as occurs in the aforementioned verse.
That is to distinguish it from the maṣdar-forming أن on which «the kāf» has entered; and when we are safe from confusion there is no need for the separation, so reflect.
2- When «يا» enters on a particle or a verb, it is parsed as a particle of alerting, contrary to those who strain and consider it a vocative particle with the one addressed implied — and there is in that what there is of far-fetchedness.

safi-cedvel:74-74.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) is resumptive; (اللام) is the lām of command; (يقاتل) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); (في سبيل) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to (يقاتل) — or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative —; (الله) is the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الذين) is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the fāʿil (agent); (يشرون) is an imperfect verb, nominative …, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الحياة) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الدنيا) is a naʿt (adjective), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (بالآخرة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يشرون) by its being made to carry the meaning of «يستبدلون», or it is in the sense of «يبيعون»; (الواو) is resumptive; (من) is a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); (يقاتل) is an imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو»; (في سبيل الله) is like the first, attached to (يقاتل) — or to a ḥāl of the fāʿil of يقاتل —; (الفاء) is a conjunction of sequel (tafrīʿiyya); (يقتل) is an imperfect verb, passive, jussive, conjoined to the protasis, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «هو»; (أو) is a conjunction; (يغلب) is like يقاتل and conjoined to it; (الفاء) links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (سوف) is a particle of futurity; (نؤتي) is an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «نحن», for majesty, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi; (أجرا) is a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (عظيما) is a naʿt, accusative.
The clause «ليقاتل … الذين يشرون» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يشرون الحياة …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «من يقاتل …» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يقاتل في سبيل الله» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».
The clause «يقتل …» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يقاتل.
The clause «يغلب …» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يقتل.
The clause «نؤتيه …» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(يشرون): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its original form is يشريون with ḍamma on the second yāʾ; then its vowel was transferred to the rāʾ, then it was dropped because of the two sukūns.

* Rhetoric:
Istiʿāra makniyya (implicit metaphor): in His saying, the Exalted: الَّذِينَ يَشْرُونَ الْحَياةَ الدُّنْيا بِالْآخِرَةِ

* Benefits:
- A point of benefit: True fighting:
After the Qurʾān alerted the Muslims to the hypocrites present among them, whom they ought to beware of as they beware of their enemies, and who look at fighting only through the lens of booty — after this the context tries to raise up these laggards weighed down to the earth, to free them from their illusions, and to awaken in their senses the aspiration to what is loftier and more lasting … the Hereafter …
Fighting is in the way of Allah, because Islam knows no fighting except in this way; it knows no fighting for booty or for domination. Islam does not sanction fighting to seize land or population, or to obtain the raw materials needed for industry, or to secure markets for disposing of products, or to secure a field for capital in colonies.
Rather, fighting is in the way of Allah, to raise high the word of Allah on earth, to enable His way to direct life, and to let humanity enjoy the blessings of this way and its absolute justice «among people», while leaving every individual free to choose the creed he is convinced of, under the shade of this general divine, humane way.

safi-cedvel:75-75.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is a conjunction; (ما) is an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject); (اللام) is a preposition and (كم) is a pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the khabar (predicate) of ما; (لا) is negating; (تقاتلون) is an imperfect verb, nominative …, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (في سبيل الله): its i'rab has just been given «[Note: In the previous verse (74).]»; (الواو) is a conjunction; (المستضعفين) is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to سبيل, genitive (majrūr) like it, on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. «تخليص المستضعفين» (the rescue of the oppressed), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (من الرجال) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of المستضعفين; (النساء، الولدان) are two nouns conjoined to الرجال by the two conjunctions, genitive like it; (الذين) is a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of المستضعفين; (يقولون) is like تقاتلون; (ربّ) is the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf), accusative (manṣūb), and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أخرجنا) is an imperative verb of supplication …, and (نا) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «أنت»; (من) is a preposition; (ها) is a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذه) is a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (أخرجنا); (القرية) is a badal (substitute) of ذه — or a naʿt of it — following it in the genitive; (الظالم) is a causal adjective (naʿt sababī) of القرية, genitive like it; (أهل) is the fāʿil of the active participle الظالم, nominative, and (ها) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) is a conjunction; (اجعل) is like خرجه «[Translator's note: so in the source; presumably «أخرجنا»]»; (لنا) is like لكم, attached to (اجعل) «[Note: Or to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi of (اجعل), if it is transitive to two objects.]»; (من) is a preposition; (لدن) is a noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of genitive, attached to a ḥāl of (وليّا) «[Note: Or attached to (اجعل), with (من) in it for the beginning of the extent.]», and (الكاف) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (وليّا) is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) is a conjunction; (اجعل … نصيرا) is like اجعل … وليّا.
The clause «ما لكم …» is a clause with no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive performative (inshāʾiyya) clause in the previous verse.
The clause «لا تقاتلون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the genitive pronoun in (لكم).
The vocative clause together with its answer is in the position of accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أخرجنا» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative.
The clause «اجعل» (the first) has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause answering the vocative.
The clause «اجعل» (the second) has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause answering the vocative.

* Morphology:
(المستضعفين): plural of المستضعف, passive participle of the six-letter verb استضعف; its pattern is مستفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(الولدان): plural of وليد or ولد, and its being the plural of the first is more regular; وليد is فعيل in the sense of مفعول, i.e. the newborn, or a boy in general, or a slave.

* Rhetoric:
«ما لَكُمْ لا تُقاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ»: an address to those commanded to fight, by way of iltifāt (shift of address) from the third person to the second person, for emphasis in inciting and urging toward it, and that is what is intended by the interrogative.

* Benefits:
1- «الظَّالِمِ أَهْلُها»: the causal adjective (naʿt sababī) and the true adjective (naʿt ḥaqīqī): The grammarians distinguished between these two adjectives:
a- The causal adjective agrees with what it follows in three things: case, definiteness and indefiniteness; in its masculine and feminine it follows the noun after it, and it always remains singular.
b- The true adjective agrees with what it qualifies in all respects, namely the case vowel, definiteness and indefiniteness, masculine and feminine, and singular, dual and plural.
3- «[Translator's note: so numbered in the source; there is no item 2.]» The active participle governs as its active verb does, and we have alluded to that in a previous place.
As for the passive participle, it governs as its passive verb does, so it puts a nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) in the nominative instead of the fāʿil — so reflect.

safi-cedvel:76-76.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject); (آمنوا) is a past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma …, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (يقاتلون في سبيل الله) is like تقاتلون في سبيل الله «[Note: In verse (75) of this sūra.]»; (الواو) is a conjunction; (الذين كفروا … سبيل الطّاغوت) is like the preceding; (الفاء) links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; (قاتلوا) is an imperative verb indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn …, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أولياء) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الشيطان) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (إنّ) is a particle resembling the verb (inna and its sisters); (كيد) is the noun of إنّ, accusative; (الشيطان) is a muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (كان) is a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters), and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو», i.e. the scheming; (ضعيفا) is the khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative.
The clause «الذين آمنوا …» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يقاتلون …» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «الذين كفروا …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «كفروا …» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «يقاتلون» (the second) is in the position of the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «قاتلوا …» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: «إن كنتم مؤمنين فقاتلوا».
The clause «إنّ كيد الشيطان …» has no grammatical position, causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «كان ضعيفا» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.

* Benefits:
With a single touch the Qurʾān places people at the parting of the ways, sets out the goals, and separates two paths: the path of Allah, for whose sake the believers fight, seeking nothing from it for themselves in the life of this world, and in which they are guaranteed triumph in advance — either triumph through victory or triumph through martyrdom.
And the path of Satan, in which those who disbelieve fight in defence of the ṭāghūt; and ṭāghūt, this comprehensive word, depicts all the meanings of misguidance, injustice, greed, exploitation and tyranny, in which people fight for the domination of an individual, or for the glory of a house, a class, a state or a race, following in that the enticement of Satan.

safi-cedvel:101-101.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إذا) an adverb for future time containing the sense of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the content of the apodosis; (ضربتم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn.. and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent); (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ضربتم); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (ليس) an incomplete (nāqiṣ), inflexible (jāmid) past verb; (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of the incomplete verb; (جناح) the postponed noun of ليس, nominative; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; (تقصروا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), the sign of the subjunctive being the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (من الصلاة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تقصروا) [Note: The verb قصر is transitive by itself and by a preposition; one says قصر الصلاة and قصر من الصلاة, meaning he left out something of it.] .
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تقصروا) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being في ... attached to what عليكم is attached to [Note: It may be attached to جناح, because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun). It is stated in al-Lisān: الجناح, with ḍamma, is inclination towards sin, and it is said that it is sin in general.] .
(إن) a jussive conditional particle; (خفتم) a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) ... and (تم) is the fāʿil; (أن يفتنكم) like أن تقصروا ...
a verb and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (كفروا) a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يفتنكم الذين ...) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الكافرين) the noun of إنّ, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (كانوا) an incomplete past verb and its noun; (لكم) like عليكم, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (عدوّا), which is the khabar of كان, accusative; (مبينا) naʿt (adjective), accusative.
The clause «ضربتم ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ليس عليكم جناح» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «تقصروا ...» has no grammatical position, ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «إن خفتم ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) ... and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: إن خفتم ... فاقصروا من الصلاة ("if you fear ..., then shorten the prayer").
The clause «يفتنكم الذين ...» has no grammatical position, ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إنّ الكافرين كانوا ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
The clause «كانوا ... عدوّا ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.

safi-cedvel:102-102.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذا) an adverb for future time containing the sense of condition, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the content of the apodosis; (كنت) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on sukūn ... and (التاء) is the noun of كان; (في) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the khabar (predicate) of كنت; (الفاء) conjunction; (أقمت) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (لهم) like فيهم, attached to (أقمت); (الصلاة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الفاء) linking the apodosis of إذا; (اللام) the lām of command; (تقم) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; (طائفة) fāʿil, nominative; (منهم) like فيهم, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of طائفة; (مع) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (تقم), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (ليأخذوا) like لتقم ... the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أسلحة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunction; (إذا) like the first; (سجدوا) a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اللام) the lām of command; (يكونوا) an incomplete imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is a pronoun, the noun of يكون; (من وراء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of يكون, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction — or resumptive — (لتأت طائفة) like لتقم طائفة..
the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the weak letter; (أخرى) naʿt of طائفة, nominative like it, the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif; (لم) a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and the jussive; (يصلّوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الفاء) conjunction; (اللام) the lām of command; (يصلّوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn ...
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (معك) like the first, attached to the second verb يصلّوا; (الواو) conjunction; (ليأخذوا) like ليصلّوا; (حذرهم) like the first أسلحتهم; (أسلحتهم) the second, conjoined by al-wāw to حذرهم — a muḍāf and muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «كنت فيهم» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «أقمت ... الصلاة» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause كنت.
The clause «تقم طائفة ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «يأخذوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تقم طائفة.
The clause «سجدوا» is in the position of genitive through the annexation of (إذا) to it.
The clause «يكونوا ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «تأت طائفة ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the apodosis clause — or resumptive.
The clause «لم يصلّوا» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of طائفة.
The clause «ليصلوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تأت.
The clause «يأخذوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ليصلّوا.
(ودّ) a past verb; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (كفروا) like سجدوا; (لو) a maṣdar-forming particle; (تغفلون) an imperfect verb, nominative ...
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (عن أسلحة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تغفلون), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (أمتعتكم) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to أسلحتكم, genitive like it; (الفاء) conjunction; (يميلون) like تغفلون; (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يميلون); (ميلة) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative; (واحدة) naʿt of ميلة, accusative like it.
The interpreted maṣdar (لو تغفلون) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, its governing word being ودّ.
(الواو) resumptive; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (جناح) the noun of لا, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (عليكم) like the first, attached to the omitted khabar of لا; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (كان) an incomplete past verb [Note: Or complete, with أذى as fāʿil and بكم attached to it.] , indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (بكم) like عليكم, attached to the khabar of كان; (أذى) the postponed noun of كان, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma on the alif; (من مطر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of أذى; (أو) a conjunction; (كنتم) like كنت; (مرضى) khabar, accusative, the sign of the accusative being an implied fatḥa on the alif; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; (تضعوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), the sign of the subjunctive being the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أسلحتكم) like the first, its governing word being تضعوا.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تضعوا ...) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being في أن تضعوا ... attached to what the preposition-phrase عليكم is attached to ... or attached to جناح.
(الواو) resumptive; (خذوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn ...
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (حذركم) like حذرهم; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of إنّ, accusative; (أعدّ) like ودّ, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (للكافرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أعدّ); (عذابا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (مهينا) naʿt, accusative.
The clause «ودّ الذين ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «تغفلون ...» has no grammatical position, ṣila of the particle relative (لو).
The clause «يميلون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تغفلون.
The clause «لا جناح عليكم» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كان بكم أذى» has no grammatical position, parenthetical ... and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it ... i.e.: إن كان بكم أذى فلا جناح عليكم ("if there is harm to you, then there is no blame on you") ...
The clause «كنتم مرضى» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كان ...
The clause «تضعوا ...» has no grammatical position, ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «خذوا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كان بكم أذى» has no grammatical position, parenthetical ... and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it ... i.e.: أن كان بكم أذى فلا جناح عليكم ...
The clause «كنتم مرضى» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كان ...
The clause «تضعوا ...» has no grammatical position, ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «خذوا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
[Translator's note: the four preceding lines repeat, in the source, the four lines before them (with «أن» printed for «إن» in the first); they are translated as written.]
The clause «إنّ الله أعدّ ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أعدّ» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(أسلحة) the plural of سلاح, a collective noun for the instruments of war, treated as masculine and feminine; its pattern is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ, and the pattern of its plural is أفعلة, which is one of the plurals of paucity.
(ميلة): a maṣdar of single occurrence (maṣdar al-marra) from مال; its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
1- «وَلْيَأْخُذُوا حِذْرَهُمْ وَأَسْلِحَتَهُمْ» ..
«حذرهم», i.e. their precaution: He likened it to the instruments with which one fortifies oneself, and for that reason ascribed "taking" to it by way of imaginative attribution (takhyīl); otherwise it is an abstract matter that cannot be described as being taken. The conjoining of His saying, Glorified is He, وَأَسْلِحَتَهُمْ to it, combining the literal and the figurative, does no harm; it is eloquence at its summit and fluency at its strongest.
2- The saying of Allah the Exalted: إِنْ كانَ بِكُمْ أَذىً — «أذى» is the noun of كان, nominative by an implied ḍamma on the alif, which is deleted in pronunciation but retained in writing because of the tanwīn. The tanwīn here is not a case-ending vowel, as some imagine; rather this tanwīn and the tanwīn of the manqūṣ noun are both not case-ending vowels. It is only because each of them is indefinite, free of the definite «ال», that the tanwīn attached to it as a sign of indefiniteness.
The maqṣūr noun takes tanwīn in all its cases when it is free of the definite ال. So we say:
هذا فتى اتبع هدى فحصل على غنى ("This is a young man who followed guidance and obtained wealth"); the alif in the three examples is deleted in pronunciation and retained in writing. As for the manqūṣ noun, which is the one ending in a quiescent yāʾ preceded by a kasra, it takes tanwīn when indefinite, and its yāʾ is deleted in the nominative and genitive because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and retained in the accusative, the fatḥa appearing on it because of its lightness: جاء قاض، مررت بقاض، رأيت قاضيا.

safi-cedvel:128-128.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إن) a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive; (امرأة) the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned after it, i.e. خافت; (خافت) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) ... and (التاء) for the feminine, and the fāʿil is an optionally latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "hiya"; (من بعل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from (نشوزا) — a naʿt (adjective) that came before what it qualifies —, and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (نشوزا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (أو) a conjunction; (إعراضا) maʿṭūf (conjoined) on (نشوزا), accusative like it; (الفاء) the connective of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) the lā of generic negation; (جناح) the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative; (على) a preposition and (هما) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of lā; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; (يصلحا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn ... and (الألف) a pronoun, fāʿil; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (يصلحا), and (هما) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (صلحا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), for it is a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يصلحا) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being "في أن يصلحا" ..., attached to the omitted khabar or to the word جناح, because it is a maṣdar.
(الواو) parenthetical; (الصلح) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (خير) khabar, nominative; (الواو) conjunctive; (أحضرت) a past verb, passive, and (التاء) for the feminine; (الأنفس) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (الشح) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunctive; (إن) like the first; (تحسنوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ...
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الواو) conjunctive; (تتقوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined on the verb تحسنوا ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الفاء) the connective of the apodosis; (إنّ الله كان) its i'rab has passed «[Note: in the previous verse (127).]»; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming (maṣdarī) particle «[Note: or a relative noun in the position of the genitive, and the clause after it has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.]»; (تعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. «[Translator's note: so in the source; the word in the verse is تعملون, as in the following line.]»
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تعملون ...) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (خبيرا).
(خبيرا) the khabar of kāna, accusative.
The implied clause «إن (خافت) امرأة» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The (mentioned) clause «خافت» has no grammatical position, explicative.
The clause «لا جناح عليهما» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of a jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يصلحا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «الصلح خير» has no grammatical position, parenthetical.
The clause «أحضرت الأنفس ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the parenthetical clause.
The clause «تحسنوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the resumptive clause إن امرأة.
The clause «تتقوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause تحسنوا.
The clause «إن الله ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of a jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «كان ... خبيرا» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of (إنّ).
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle or the nominal relative.

* Morphology:
(نشوزا): an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb نشز ينشز, of the bāb نصر and the bāb ضرب, its pattern فعول with ḍamma on the fāʾ (al-Nisāʾ 34).
(إعراضا): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb أعرض, its pattern إفعال.
(صلحا): a noun of maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb أصلح, its pattern فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.
(الشح): an aural maṣdar of the verb شحّ يشحّ, of the first, second and third bābs, its pattern فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.

* Benefits:
His saying, the Exalted, ﴿وَإِنِ امْرَأَةٌ خافَتْ﴾: إن is conditional, and امرأة is the fāʿil of an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned, the implied sense being "and if a woman fears, [she] fears". It is not permissible to parse امرأة as a mubtadaʾ — contrary to the Kufans — because conditional إن and most conditional particles are specific to entering upon verbs. Like it in ruling is إذا, its example being: ﴿إِذَا السَّماءُ انْشَقَّتْ﴾, where we parse السماء as the fāʿil of an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned, and the omitted verb with the fāʿil السماء is a clause in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), and the clause انشقت is explicative with no grammatical position. Likewise in the verse, the implied clause خافت امرأة, the protasis, has no grammatical position, and the second clause خافت is explicative with no grammatical position.

safi-cedvel:129-129.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لن) a particle of negation and subjunctive; (تستطيعوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; (تعدلوا) like تستطيعوا; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تعدلوا); (النساء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الواو) circumstantial; (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (حرصتم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn ... and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تعدلوا) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "you will not be able to do justice between the women".
(الفاء) the connective of the apodosis of an implied condition; (لا) prohibitive, making the verb jussive; (تميلوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (كل) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), because it is annexed to the maṣdar; (الميل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الفاء) the fāʾ of causation «[Note: it is permissible for the fāʾ to be conjunctive, and the verb after it jussive, conjoined on the prohibited (تميلوا).]»; (تذروا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive by an implied أن after the fāʾ ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (كالمعلّقة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the accusative pronoun in (تذروها).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تذروها) is conjoined on a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, the implied sense being "let there not be from you an inclining away from her and then a leaving of her".
(الواو) conjunctive; (إن تصلحوا ... رحيما) the i'rab of its like has passed «[Note: in the previous verse (128).]».
The clause «لن تستطيعوا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تعدلوا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «لو حرصتم» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the fāʿil of تستطيعوا ...
And the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "if you were eager for justice, you would still not be able to do that".
The clause «لا تميلوا ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.:
"if some shortcoming in equality occurs from you, then do not incline or act unjustly".
The clause «تذروها ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن) «[Note: or conjoined on the clause لا تميلوا.]».
The clause «إنّ تصلحوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the resumptive clause.
The clause «تتّقوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause تصلحوا.
The clause «إنّ الله ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «كان غفورا ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of (إنّ).

* Morphology:
(المعلّقة): a feminine passive participle, its masculine المعلّق, from the quadriliteral verb علّق, its pattern مفعلة with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the lām.

* Benefits:
Justice is only in conduct:
Allah, who created the human soul, knows of its nature that it has inclinations it does not control.
Among these inclinations is that the heart inclines to one of the wives and prefers her over the others, and this is an inclination over which one has no power. The Quran tells people frankly that they will never be able to do justice between women in their heart's inclination, for love is outside the will.
But there is what is within the will: justice in conduct, justice in the division [of nights], justice in maintenance, justice in all the marital rights.
- His saying, the Exalted, ﴿فَلا تَمِيلُوا كُلَّ الْمَيْلِ﴾: كلّ is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative. It is a noun parsed according to its place in the sentence: it may be a fāʿil, a mafʿūl bihi or a mubtadaʾ (subject); it may be parsed as an adverb when annexed to an adverb, as in His saying, the Exalted, ﴿تُؤْتِي أُكُلَها كُلَّ حِينٍ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّها﴾; and it is also parsed as tawkīd (emphasis), in which case it must be preceded by what it emphasizes and must contain a pronoun referring back to what is emphasized, as in His saying, the Exalted: ﴿فَسَجَدَ الْمَلائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ﴾.

safi-cedvel:130-130.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive; (إن) a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive; (يتفرقا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and (الألف) the fāʿil (agent); (يغن) an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (كلّا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (من سعة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يغني), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) resumptive; (كان الله واسعا) the i'rab of its like has preceded «[Note: in verse (129) of this sura.]»; (حكيما) a second khabar (predicate), accusative.
The clause «يتفرقا» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause تصلحوا «[Note: in verse (129) ... or conjoined on the clause إن امرأة خافت in verse (128), with what is between them being parenthetical, according to the view of Abū Ḥayyān.]».
The clause «يغن الله» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «كان الله واسعا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(يغن): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion due to the jussive; its pattern is يفع with ḍamma on the yāʾ.

safi-cedvel:131-131.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); (في السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما; (الواو) conjunctive; (ما في الأرض) like the preceding and conjoined on it; (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied (muqaddar) oath; (قد) a particle of realization; (وصينا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أوتوا) a past verb, passive, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (الكتاب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أوتوا), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunctive; (إياكم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative, maʿṭūf (conjoined) on the relative noun ... and (كم) a particle of address; (أن) an explicative particle «[Note: or a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, namely the bāʾ.]»; (اتقوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) resumptive or conjunctive; (إن تكفروا) like إن تحسنوا; (الفاء) the connective of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (لله) like the first, attached to the khabar of inna; (ما) like the first, the noun of inna, in the position of the accusative; (في السموات وما في الأرض) like the first; (الواو) resumptive; (كان الله غنيا) like كان الله واسعا «[Note: in verse (130) of this sura.]»; (حميدا) a second khabar, accusative.
The clause «لله ما في السموات ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «وصّينا ...» has no grammatical position, the answer of an implied oath, and the oath clause has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أوتوا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «اتقوا ...» has no grammatical position, explicative «[Note: or it has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).]».
The clause «تكفروا» has no grammatical position, resumptive — or conjoined on the explicative clause.
The clause «إنّ لله ما في السموات» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of a jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «كان الله غنيا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Benefits:
His saying, the Exalted, ﴿أَنِ اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾: أن is either maṣdar-forming, so that it and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) made genitive by the bāʾ, the implied sense being "We enjoined you with fear of Allah"; or it is explicative in the sense of "that is" (أي), and the clause after it is parsed as an explicative clause with no grammatical position. We shall now clarify something about explicative (أن). Among its conditions:
1- That it be preceded by a clause and followed by a clause, as in His saying, the Exalted: ﴿فَأَوْحَيْنا إِلَيْهِ أَنِ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنا﴾.
2- That the preceding clause contain the meaning of speech, like "I revealed", "I indicated" or "I signalled", its example being: ﴿وَانْطَلَقَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ امْشُوا﴾, and the "setting off" here is the setting off of the tongue.
3- That no preposition enter upon it; so if you said «كتبت إليه بأن احضر» ("I wrote to him to come"), it would be maṣdar-forming.
A benefit: In Mughnī al-Labīb the following has come on this subject: if أن that is suitable for explanation is followed by an imperfect verb preceded by «لا», as in «أشرت إليه أن لا تفعل» ("I indicated to him not to do it"), it is permissible to make it nominative on taking «لا» as negating, and jussive on taking it as prohibitive, and on both readings «أن» remains explicative. If «لا» is dropped, the jussive is excluded, and the nominative is permissible if we consider أن explicative, and the subjunctive if we consider it maṣdar-forming.

safi-cedvel:35-35.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (خفتم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (تم) an agent pronoun; (شقاق) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (بين) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) [Note: (بين) here has the adverbial meaning; the original is «شقاقا بينهما», but its use was extended, so the event was annexed to its adverb while its adverbial sense remains, like His saying: مكر الليل والنهار (Ḥāshiyat al-Jalālayn: al-Jamal) ... and it may have been used as a noun with the adverbial meaning gone ...], (هما) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (ابعثوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), (حكما) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من أهل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (حكما), (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (حكما) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the first, accusative like it; (من أهلها) like the first; (إن) like the first; (يريدا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and (الألف) an agent pronoun; (إصلاحا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (يوفّق) an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis, and it was given kasra because of the meeting of two quiescents; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (بين) an adverb, accusative, attached to (يوفق), and (هما) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إنّ الله كان عليما خبيرا) the i'rab of its counterpart has passed in the preceding verse.
The clause «خفتم ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ابعثوا ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of the condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إن يريدا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive, having the force of a causal explanation.
The clause «يوفّق الله ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إنّ الله كان ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كان عليما ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna.

* Morphology:
(حكما): the word is originally derived from the verb حكم يحكم, of the bāb of نصر, so it is a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective); its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas; it may be transferred to a noun denoting one who decides between two disputants or two who differ ... and it is applied to the singular and the plural.
(إصلاحا): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the quadriliteral verb أصلح; its pattern is إفعال, with kasra on the hamza of the past tense and the addition of an alif before the last letter.

* Benefits:
1- The jurists said: if discord arises from both spouses together, the judge settles them next to a trustworthy person who looks into their affair and prevents the wrongdoer of them from wrongdoing. If their affair worsens and their dispute is prolonged, the judge sends a trustworthy person from the woman's family and a trustworthy person from the man's family, to meet and look into their affair and do what is in their interest, whether separation or reconciliation, while taking into account the Lawgiver's eagerness for reconciliation ...

safi-cedvel:36-36.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اعبدوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunctive; (لا) the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā; (تشركوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تشركوا), (شيئا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunctive; (بالوالدين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "take to heart [the charge]" (استوصوا), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, (إحسانا) mafʿūl bihi, its governor being the implied verb, accusative [Note: see further explanation, detail and derivation of the word in the footnote to verse (83) of Sūrat al-Baqara.], (الواو) conjunctive; (بذي) like (بالوالدين), and it is attached to what that is attached to ... the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (القربى) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الواو) conjunctive; (اليتامى) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (ذي القربى), genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the alif ... and likewise (المساكين، الجار), both conjoined to (ذي القربى), genitive; (ذي) a naʿt (adjective) of (الجار), genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (القربى) like the first; (الواو) conjunctive; (الجار) maʿṭūf to (ذي القربى), genitive like it; (الجنب) a naʿt of (الجار), genitive; (الواو) conjunctive; (الصاحب) maʿṭūf to (ذي القربى); (بالجنب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (الصاحب); (الواو) conjunctive; (ابن) maʿṭūf to (ذي القربى), genitive like it; (السبيل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunctive; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the first genitive; (ملكت) a past verb ... and (التاء) is for the feminine;
