(أيمان) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna; (لا) negative; (يحب) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "He"; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (كان) a defective past verb, and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he", and it is the referring pronoun; (مختالا) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative; (فخورا) a second khabar, accusative.
The clause «اعبدوا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا تشركوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «(استوصوا)» بالوالدين» [Translator's note: the quotation marks are so in the source.] has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «ملكت أيمانكم» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «إنّ الله لا يحب ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا يحب من ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «كان مختالا» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (من).

* Morphology:
(الجار): a derived adjective from the quadriliteral جاور; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn, and the alif was originally a wāw, because the maṣdar is جوار and مجاورة, and because the wāw appears in the quadriliteral.
(الجنب): its plural is جنوب; a noun for the side of a person and others; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(مختالا): an active participle from the five-letter اختال, so it is on the pattern of its imperfect, with the prefix of the imperfect replaced by a mīm with ḍamma and the letter before the last given kasra; but the kasra does not appear before the last letter because the verb is weak in the imperfect, so the kasra is implied on the alif ...
For this reason this word is also identical with the passive participle. And it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl); its original form is مختيل; the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted to an alif.
(فخورا): a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) from فخر يفخر, of the bāb of فرح; its pattern is فعول with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

* Benefits:
1- The right of Allah over His servants:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Muʿādh ibn Jabal: "Do you know what the right of Allah over the servants is?" He said:
"Allah and His Messenger know best." He said: «That they worship Him and associate nothing with Him.» Then he said: "Do you know what the right of the servants over Allah is?" «If they do that, that Allah will not punish them.»

safi-cedvel:37-37.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative (manṣūb), a badal (substitute) of the relative (من) in the preceding verse [Note: or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "they" ... or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being "will be punished".] (يبخلون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الواو) conjunctive; (يأمرون) like (يبخلون); (الناس) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (بالبخل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يأمرون), (الواو) conjunctive; (يكتمون) like (يبخلون); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (آتى) a past verb, indeclinable on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (من فضل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the referring accusative pronoun; (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (الواو) resumptive; (أعتدنا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (نا) an agent pronoun; (للكافرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أعتدنا), (عذابا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (مهينا) naʿt (adjective), accusative.
The clause «يبخلون ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يأمرون ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يكتمون ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «آتاهم الله ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «أعتدنا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(البخل): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb بخل يبخل, of the bāb of كرم; as for the bāb of فرح, its maṣdar is بخل with two fatḥas. In al-Qāmūs al-Muḥīṭ: «البخل and البخول, with ḍamma on the bāʾ in both, and like جبل, نجم and عنق: the opposite of generosity ... بخل, like فرح and كرم, بخلا with ḍamma and with vowelling ... etc.»

* Rhetoric:
«وَأَعْتَدْنا لِلْكافِرِينَ عَذاباً مُهِيناً»: the overt noun is put in the place of the pronoun to signal that whoever is like this is ungrateful for (kāfir bi-) the blessing of Allah the Exalted, and whoever is ungrateful for the blessing of Allah the Exalted has a punishment that humiliates him, just as he humiliated the blessing by stinginess and concealment.

safi-cedvel:38-38.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive; (الذين ينفقون) like (الذين يبخلون) in the preceding verse, and conjoined to it; (أموال) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (رئاء) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), interpreted as a derived word, i.e. "showing off", accusative [Note: or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative.] (الناس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الواو) conjunctive; (لا) negative; (يؤمنون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤمنون), (الواو) conjunctive; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation; (باليوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what (بالله) is attached to, so it is conjoined to it; (الآخر) a naʿt (adjective) of (اليوم), genitive like it; (الواو) resumptive; (من) a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يكن) a defective imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and it was given kasra because of the meeting of two quiescents; (الشيطان) the noun of (يكن), nominative; (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a ḥāl of (قرينا), and this latter is the khabar (predicate) of (يكن), accusative; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (ساء) a non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb [Note: that is because the apodosis here is joined with the fāʾ; if the verb (ساء) were inflecting, there would be no need for the fāʾ.] for expressing blame, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he", referring back to Satan; (قرينا) tamyīz (specification), accusative, specifying the latent pronoun.
The clause «ينفقون ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لا يؤمنون ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «من يكن الشيطان ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يكن الشيطان ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: the khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «ساء ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(قرينا): a derived adjective from the verb قرن يقرن, of the bāb of ضرب; its pattern is فعيل, either in the sense of مفعول or in the sense of فاعل; it may be an intensive form of the active participle, or a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) for the active participle, derived irregularly from the transitive verb.

* Benefits:
1- Showing off:
It has come in the ḥadīth of the three who are the first with whom the Fire will be kindled, namely: the scholar, the fighter, and the spenders who show off with their deeds. The owner of wealth says: «I did not leave anything in which You love that money be spent except that I spent in Your path.» Then Allah says: «You have lied; you only wanted it to be said:
"generous", and it has been said» — i.e. you have taken your reward in this world, and that is what you wanted by your deed [Translator's note: the source prints «يعملك», evidently for «بعملك».].
Satan led them to divert their deeds from sincerity for the sake of Allah to hypocrisy and showing off, so their reward was the Fire.

safi-cedvel:77-77.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) is for the interrogative of wonder (taʿajjub); (تر) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «أنت»; (إلى) is a preposition; (الذين) is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached (mutaʿalliq) to (تر) by its being made to carry the meaning of «تنظر»; (قيل) is a past verb, passive; (اللام) is a preposition and (هم) is a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (قيل); (كفّوا) is an imperative verb indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn …, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أيدي) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (كم) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) is a conjunction; (أقيموا الصلاة) is like كفّوا أيديكم, and likewise (آتوا الزكاة). (الفاء) is resumptive; (لما) is an adverb in the sense of «حين», carrying the meaning of the condition, attached to the content of the meaning of the apodosis, i.e. «ظهرت خشيتهم»; (كتب) is like قيل; (عليهم) is like لهم, attached to (كتب); (القتال) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (إذا) is the inoperative إذا of surprise (fujāʾiyya); (فريق) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative «[Note: What permitted beginning with an indefinite is its being qualified by the preposition phrase.]»; (منهم) is like لهم, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of فريق; (يخشون) is an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الناس) is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (كخشية) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); (الله) is the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (أو) is a conjunction; (أشد) is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to خشية, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa in place of the kasra, because it is a diptote on account of being an adjective and of the pattern أفعل «[Note: Or it is conjoined to the implied mafʿūl muṭlaq, and it has stood in for the maṣdar.]»; (خشية) is a tamyīz (specification), accusative «[Note: See verse (200) of Sūrat al-Baqara.]». (الواو) is a conjunction; (قالوا) is a past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma …, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (ربّ) is the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf), accusative, and (نا) is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (اللام) is a preposition; (ما) is an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (كتبت); and (كتبت) is a past verb and its fāʿil; (علينا) is like عليهم, attached to the verb (كتبت); (القتال) is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (لولا) is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); (أخّرتنا) is a past verb indeclinable on the sukūn, and (التاء) is the fāʿil, and (نا) is the mafʿūl bihi; (إلى أجل) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أخّرتنا); (قريب) is a naʿt of أجل, genitive like it. (قل) is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «أنت»; (متاع) is a mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الدنيا) is a muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (قليل) is the khabar (predicate), nominative; (الواو) is a conjunction; (الآخرة) is a mubtadaʾ, nominative; (خير) is the khabar, nominative; (اللام) is a preposition; (من) is a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (خير); (اتقى) is a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being «هو», and it is the resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid); (الواو) is a conjunction; (لا) is negating; (تظلمون) is an imperfect verb, passive, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn …, and the wāw is an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil; (فتيلا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar because it is its description, i.e. «ظلما قدر الفتيل».
The clause «ألم تر …» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «قيل لهم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «كفوا أيديكم» is in the position of nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil «[Note: In the view of the majority, the nāʾib fāʿil is implied, i.e. «القول». (See verse (11) of Sūrat al-Baqara.)]».
The clause «أقيموا …» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause كفّوا.
The clause «آتوا …» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause كفوا.
The clause «كتب عليهم» is in the position of genitive as a muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «فريق منهم يخشون» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «يخشون …» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ فريق.
The clause «قالوا …» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يخشون.
The clause «ربّنا لم كتبت …» is in the position of accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لم كتبت …» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative.
The clause «أخّرتنا …» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «قل …» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «متاع الدنيا قليل» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «الآخرة خير» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause متاع الدنيا قليل.
The clause «اتّقى» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «لا تظلمون …» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the khabar خير, with a linking pronoun implied in it, i.e.: «لا تظلمون فيها فتيلا».

* Benefits:
1- At the beginning of Islam, while they were in Mecca, the believers were commanded to pray and to give zakāt — even though it was not with the set thresholds (niṣāb) — and they were commanded to console the poor among them, and to pardon and forgive the polytheists and to be patient for a time. They were burning with eagerness and wished they were commanded to fight, so as to have satisfaction from their enemies. The situation at that time was not suitable, for many reasons, among them their small number in proportion to the great number of their enemy, and among them their being in their own town, which is a sacred town and the noblest spot on earth.
So the command to fight in it was not at the outset, as it is said; for this reason jihad was not commanded except in Medina, when they had a home, protection and helpers. Yet even so, when they were commanded with what they used to wish for, some of them were alarmed by it and feared facing people with intense fear.
2- His saying, the Exalted: إِذا فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمْ يَخْشَوْنَ النَّاسَ كَخَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ — إذا in the noble verse is a particle and is parsed as the إذا of surprise; it is followed by the mubtadaʾ and the khabar, and sometimes it is followed by a nominal clause headed by إنّ, as in our saying: «إن خرجت فإذا إن المطر نازل». Most of its occurrences come after a condition, as in the noble verse. But if it is joined to the apodosis of a jussive condition, the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, as in His saying, the Exalted, in Sūrat al-Rūm: وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِما قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ. This is the preferred and strongest of the grammarians' views; some of them took a tortuous path and made it an adverb of time or of place, and that led them to interpretations and contrivances of no value.
3- His saying, the Exalted: لِمَ كَتَبْتَ عَلَيْنَا الْقِتالَ — لم is composed of the genitive lām and the interrogative ما; note the dropping of the alif from the interrogative ما because a preposition precedes it, and this is regular whenever a preposition enters on it, as in: لم - علام - إلام - فيم - ممّ - حتام … etc.

safi-cedvel:78-78.t:
* I'rab:
(أينما) is a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), attached (mutaʿalliq) to the apodosis يدرك «[Note: It may be attached to the verb تكونوا because it is complete (tāmm).]»; (تكونوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn …, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) of the complete تكون; (يدرك) is an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and (كم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الموت) is the fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (الواو) is a conjunction; (لو) is a non-jussive conditional; (كنتم) is a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters) indeclinable on the sukūn …, and (تم) is a pronoun, the noun of كان «[Note: The verb may be complete, with (في بروج) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil.]»; (في بروج) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar (predicate) of كان; (مشيدة) is a naʿt (adjective) of بروج, genitive like it. (الواو) is resumptive; (إن) is a jussive conditional particle; (تصب) is an imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis, and (هم) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (حسنة) is the fāʿil, nominative; (يقولوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn …, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (ها) is a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذه) is a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); (من عند) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (الله) is the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الواو) is a conjunction; (إن تصبهم … من عندك) is like its counterpart above; (قل) is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «أنت»; (كل) is a mubtadaʾ, nominative «[Note: What permitted beginning with it is its indicating generality, and the muḍāf ilayhi is understood from the context of the speech before it, i.e. each one of the good and the bad.]»; (من عند الله) is like the first. (الفاء) is resumptive; (ما) is an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as a mubtadaʾ; (اللام) is a preposition; (ها) is a particle of alerting; (أولاء) is a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted khabar of ما; (القوم) is a badal (substitute) of أولاء — or a naʿt of it — following it in the genitive; (لا) is negating; (يكادون) is a defective imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the noun of يكاد; (يفقهون) is an imperfect verb, nominative …, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (حديثا) is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb).
The clause «تكونوا …» is a clause with no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يدرككم الموت» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «كنتم في بروج …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: «لو كنتم في بروج مشيدة لأدرككم الموت».
The clause «تصبهم حسنة …» has no grammatical position, resumptive «[Note: Or conjoined to the first resumptive clause.]».
The clause «يقولوا …» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إن تصبهم سيئة …» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تصبهم حسنة.
The clause «يقولوا …» (the second) has no grammatical position, being the apodosis not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «هذه من عندك» is in the position of accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl) … and likewise the clause هذه من عند الله.
The clause «قل …» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كل من عند الله» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «ما لهؤلاء …» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا يكادون …» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of القوم or of أولاء.
The clause «يفقهون …» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of يكادون.

* Morphology:
(بروج): plural of برج, a non-derived (jāmid) noun; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.
(مشيدة): feminine of مشيد, passive participle of the quadriliteral شيد; its pattern is مفعّل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the doubled ʿayn.
(تصبهم): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion because of the jussive; its original form is تصيب; two sukūns met, so the yāʾ was dropped; its pattern is تفلهم.
(حديثا): a noun for what is reported, or it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the quadriliteral verb حدّث; its pattern is فعيل.

* Benefits:
Death is a reality — man is inevitably bound for death. Allah the Exalted said: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْها فانٍ; and Allah the Exalted said: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ; and Allah the Exalted said: وَما جَعَلْنا لِبَشَرٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ الْخُلْدَ. What is meant is that everyone is inevitably going to die, and nothing saves him from that, whether he strives in jihad or does not.
Death is decreed at its appointed time; it has no relation to war and peace, nor any relation to the fortification of the place in which the individual shelters; so the postponement of the obligation of fighting from him does not postpone it.
So there is no sense, then, in wishing for the postponement of fighting, and no sense in fearing people, in fighting or otherwise.
That is a touch by which the Qurʾān treats everything that crosses the Muslim's mind regarding this matter.
This does not mean that man should not take his caution and precaution and every preparation and readiness within his capacity … For Allah has already commanded them to take caution, and commanded them to take precautions in the prayer of fear; but all this is one thing, and making death and the appointed term depend on it is another thing. Taking caution and completing preparedness is a matter that must be obeyed, and it has its manifest and hidden wisdom, and behind it is the disposing of Allah; and the correct conception of the true relation between death and the appointed term — despite every preparation and precaution — is another matter that must be obeyed, and it has its manifest and hidden wisdom.
- His saying, the Exalted: أَيْنَما تَكُونُوا يُدْرِكْكُمُ الْمَوْتُ وَلَوْ كُنْتُمْ فِي بُرُوجٍ مُشَيَّدَةٍ — this verse halts man before his inevitable destiny of death; it embodies this idea and deepens it in the soul and the conscience by various styles, and makes of it a magnificent artistic image that astonishes the mind and the senses. Death is embodied as though it were a creature, by way of the istiʿāra makniyya (implicit metaphor) in His saying يدرككم; then the imagination roams to contemplate death's power to reach any place and any direction in His saying, the Exalted, أَيْنَما تَكُونُوا; then it disappoints the hope in any attempt at escape by His saying وَلَوْ كُنْتُمْ فِي بُرُوجٍ مُشَيَّدَةٍ. So here we are with the human soul hiding from death on every path and in every direction, so much so that it tries to ascend to the sky, but death lies in wait for it and pursues it, so it never escapes. This verse represents man's deepest feelings in his fear of death and his attempt to flee; yet it frees him from fear and instils in his heart that death is a reality about which there is no doubt.

safi-cedvel:103-103.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (إذا) its i'rab has been given «1» , (قضيتم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn ... (وتم) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent); (الصلاة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اذكروا) like خذوا «2» , (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (قياما) an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial) [Note: It is the plural of قائم, or it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl, or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) (see verse 191 of Surat Āl ʿImrān).] , (الواو) conjunction; (قعودا) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (قياما), accusative like it; (الواو) conjunction; (على جنوب) a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunction; (إذا اطمأننتم) like إذا قضيتم; (فأقيموا الصلاة) like اذكروا الله; (إنّ الصلاة) like إنّ الله [Note: in the previous verse (102).] , (كانت) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb.. and (التاء) the tāʾ of the feminine, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "hiya"; (على المؤمنين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كتابا), since it is a maṣdar; it is the khabar (predicate) of كانت, accusative; (موقوتا) naʿt (adjective), accusative.
The clause «قضيتم ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «اذكروا ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «اطمأننتم» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «أقيموا الصلاة» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of the second non-jussive condition.
The clause «إنّ الصلاة كانت ...» has no grammatical position, giving the reason.
The clause «كانت ... كتابا» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إن.

* Morphology:
(اطمأننتم): augmented from the four-letter root by two letters, namely the hamza and the doubling of the nūn; its verb is اطمأن, of the pattern افعللّ. (موقوتا): a passive participle from وقت يقت, of the class of ضرب; its pattern is مفعول.

safi-cedvel:104-104.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لا) the prohibitive lā that makes the verb jussive; (تهنوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (في ابتغاء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تهنوا); (القوم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (تكونوا) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the noun of تكونوا; (تألمون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ; (يألمون) like تألمون; (الكاف) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (تألمون) like the first.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تألمون) is in the position of genitive by al-kāf, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. ألما كألمكم ("a pain like your pain").
(الواو) resumptive; (ترجون) like تألمون; (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ترجون); (ما) a relative noun [Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified.] in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لا) negative; (يرجون) like تألمون; (الواو) resumptive; (كان) an incomplete past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of كان, nominative; (عليما) khabar (predicate), accusative; (حكيما) a second khabar, accusative.
The clause «لا تهنوا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إن تكونوا ...» has no grammatical position, giving the reason.
The clause «تألمون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of تكونوا.
The clause «إنهم يألمون» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with al-fāʾ.
The clause «يألمون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «تألمون» has no grammatical position, ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «ترجون» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يرجون» has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative noun (ما) [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of (ما), if it is parsed as an indefinite noun qualified.] .
The clause «كان الله عليما» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(تهنوا): it contains iʿlāl (phonological change) by deletion; its fāʾ was deleted because it is a weak verb of the mithāl type (first radical weak) with kasra on the ʿayn in the imperfect; its pattern is تعلوا.
(ترجون): it contains iʿlāl by deletion; its lām, which is the wāw, was deleted because it came quiescent before the quiescent wāw of the plural; its pattern is تفعون.
(يرجون): like ترجون.

safi-cedvel:105-105.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ; (أنزلنا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn.. and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent); (إلى) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزل); (الكتاب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (بالحق) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الكتاب; (اللام) the lām of reason (lām al-taʿlīl); (تحكم) an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "anta"; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (تحكم); (الناس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تحكم) is in the position of genitive, attached to (أنزلنا).
(الباء) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (تحكم); (أرى) a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi ... and the second object is omitted, i.e. أراك إياه ("He showed it to you"); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (الواو) resumptive; (لا) the prohibitive lā that makes the verb jussive; (تكن) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), its noun a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anta"; (للخائنين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خصيما), which is the khabar (predicate) of تكن, accusative ...
and the lām means "for the sake of".
The clause «إنّا أنزلنا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أنزلنا ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «تحكم ...» has no grammatical position, ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative.
The clause «أراك الله» has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «لا تكن ... خصيما» has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: Or conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e.: فاحكم به ولا تكن ... ("so judge by it, and do not be ...").] .

* Morphology:
(الخائنين): the plural of الخائن, an active participle from خان يخون; its pattern is فاعل, and it contains the conversion of the weak letter — the ʿayn of the word — into a hamza, and this conversion is regular.
(خصيما), i.e. one who disputes on their behalf ... an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from خصم يخصم, of the class of ضرب; فعيل in the sense of فاعل.

* Benefits:
A word on the ijtihād of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ:
1- His saying (لِتَحْكُمَ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِما أَراكَ اللَّهُ) was adduced as evidence by those scholars of uṣūl who held that he ﷺ was entitled to judge by ijtihād (independent reasoning) — by this verse and by what is established
in the two Ṣaḥīḥs from Hishām ibn ʿUrwa from Umm Salama, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ heard the clamour of disputants at the door of his chamber, so he went out to them and said: «Indeed I am only a human being, and I judge only according to what I hear; perhaps one of you is more eloquent in his argument than another, so I judge in his favour. So whomever I judge in favour of with the right of a Muslim, it is only a piece of the Fire, so let him carry it or leave it» .

safi-cedvel:106-107.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (استغفر) an imperative verb; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "anta"; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of إنّ, accusative; (كان) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (غفورا) the khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative; (رحيما) a second khabar, accusative.
The clause «استغفر الله» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تكن [Note: in the previous verse.] .
The clause «إنّ الله كان ...» has no grammatical position, giving the reason.
The clause «كان غفورا ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
(الواو) conjunction; (لا) the prohibitive lā that makes the verb jussive; (تجادل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anta"; (عن) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تجادل), by making it include the sense of تدافع ("defend"); (يختانون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أنفس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إن الله) like the first; (لا) negative; (يحبّ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (كان خوّانا أثيما) parsed like كان غفورا رحيما.
The clause «لا تجادل ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تكن [Note: in verse (105) of this surah.] .
The clause «يختانون ...» has no grammatical position, ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إنّ الله لا يحب ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive, giving the reason.
The clause «لا يحب ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «كان خوانا ...» has no grammatical position, ṣila of the relative noun (من).

* Morphology:
(خوّانا): an intensive form of the active participle (ṣīghat mubālagha), from خان يخون; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
«إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يُحِبُّ مَنْ كانَ خَوَّاناً أَثِيماً»
...
Intensification (mubālagha): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «خَوَّاناً أَثِيماً»:
much given to treachery, excessive in it; «أثيما», immersed in sin. Attaching the absence of love — by which hatred and displeasure are meant — to the intensive form is not to restrict it to that, but to show the excess of Banū Ubayriq and their people in treachery and sin.

safi-cedvel:132-132.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive; (لله ما في السموات ... والأرض) its i'rab has passed «[Note: in the previous verse (131).]»; (الواو) resumptive; (كفى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (الله) the Name of Majesty, genitive in form, nominative in position, the fāʿil (agent) of كفى; (وكيلا) tamyīz (specification), accusative (manṣūb), or a ḥāl (circumstantial).
The clause «لله ما في السموات» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause لله ما في السموات in the previous verse.
The clause «كفى بالله وكيلا» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

safi-cedvel:133-133.t:
* I'rab:
(إن) a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive; (يشأ) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", i.e. Allah; (يذهب) an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (أي) the one addressed, a specific indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and (ها) a particle of alerting; (الناس) a badal (substitute) from أي, following it in the nominative in form; (الواو) conjunctive; (يأت) an imperfect verb, jussive, maʿṭūf (conjoined) on the apodosis, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (بآخرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يأت), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (الواو) resumptive; (كان الله قديرا) like كان الله واسعا «[Note: in verse (130) of this sura.]»; (على) a preposition; (ذا) a noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive, attached to (قديرا).
The clause «يشأ» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يذهبكم» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The vocative clause «أيها الناس» has no grammatical position, parenthetical.
The clause «يأت ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the apodosis clause.
The clause «كان الله ... قديرا» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(يأت): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion due to the jussive; its pattern is يفع (al-Baqara 106).

safi-cedvel:134-134.t:
* I'rab:
(من) a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (كان) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (يريد) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (ثواب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الدنيا) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الفاء) the connective of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (عند) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (ثواب) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الدنيا) like the first; (الواو) conjunctive; (الآخرة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) on الدنيا, genitive like it; (الواو) resumptive; (كان الله سميعا) like كان الله واسعا «[Note: in the previous verse (130).]»; (بصيرا) a second khabar, accusative.
The clause «من كان ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كان يريد ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: it is permissible for the khabar to be the two clauses of protasis and apodosis together.]».
The clause «عند الله ثواب ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of a jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «كان الله سميعا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

safi-cedvel:135-135.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) a vocative particle; (أي) the one addressed, a specific indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and (ها) a particle of alerting; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) from أي or a naʿt (adjective) of it; (آمنوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (كونوا) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is a pronoun, the noun of كونوا; (قوّامين) khabar (predicate), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (بالقسط) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قوامين; (شهداء) the second khabar of the incomplete verb, accusative «[Note: it is permissible for it to be a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in قوّامين.]», barred from nunation, joined to the nouns ending in the extended alif; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شهداء; (الواو) conjunctive; (لو) a non-jussive conditional; (على أنفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of kāna, which is omitted together with its noun after لو, the implied sense being "even if the testimony were established against yourselves" «[Note: it is permissible to attach it to an omitted verb, its implied form being "you testified against yourselves".]», and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أو) a conjunction; (الوالدين) maʿṭūf (conjoined) on أنفس with the preposition على implied, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (الواو) conjunctive; (الأقربين) conjoined on الوالدين, genitive (majrūr) like it, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (إن) a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive; (يكن) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) — incomplete —, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", i.e. each one of the one testified against or the one testified for; (غنيا) the khabar of يكن, accusative; (أو) a conjunction «[Note: here it is for detailing, for each one of the one testified for and the one testified against may be poor or rich, or both may be rich or both poor ... etc.; so the pronoun in (بهما) refers to the one testified against and the one testified for, whatever description they have. Summarized from al-ʿUkbarī.]»; (فقيرا) conjoined on (غنيا), accusative like it; (الفاء) causal — or the connective of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) —; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (أولى) khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الباء) a preposition and (هما) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to أولى; (الفاء) resumptive; (لا) prohibitive, making the verb jussive; (تتبعوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الهوى) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; (تعدلوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تعدلوا) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, namely the lām of cause, i.e. "so that you act justly" ..., attached to (تتبعوا) ... and it is a cause of the thing prohibited, which is desire, i.e. "do not follow desire for the sake of justice".
(الواو) resumptive; (إن) like the first; (تلووا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أو) a conjunction; (تعرضوا) like تلووا and conjoined on it; (الفاء) the connective of the apodosis; (إن) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (كان) an incomplete past verb, and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming (maṣdarī) particle «[Note: or a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (خبيرا).]»; (تعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (خبيرا) the khabar of kāna, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تعملون) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (خبيرا).
The vocative clause «يأيها الذين ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «كونوا ...» has no grammatical position, the answer to the vocative.
The clause «(كانت الشهادة) على أنفسكم» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause that answers the vocative ... and the apodosis is omitted, i.e. "the testimony would be obligatory upon you" «[Note: Abū Ḥayyān chose to imply the apodosis as follows: "if you are witnesses against yourselves, then be witnesses for Allah".]».
The clause «يكن غنيا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive ... and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "then do not refrain from testimony seeking the pleasure of the rich or out of pity for the poor".
The clause «الله أولى بهما» has no grammatical position, causal, mentioned to clarify the apodosis clause and give its cause «[Note: it is permissible to make the clause the apodosis without any implied element, for brevity, according to the view of Ibn Hishām; and it is parenthetical according to the view of Ibn Mālik.]», the implied sense being "so do not conceal the testimony out of compassion for them, because Allah is more entitled [to them] and more merciful".
The clause «لا تتبعوا الهوى» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تعدلوا» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «تلووا» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تعرضوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause تلووا.
The clause «إنّ الله كان ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of a jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «كان ... خبيرا» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (ما) «[Note: or the ṣila of the nominal relative.]».

* Morphology:
(الهوى): an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb هوي يهوى, of the bāb فرح; the alif is converted from a yāʾ, and it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion.

* Benefits:
The omission of kāna and its noun:
- His saying, the Exalted: ﴿وَلَوْ عَلى أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾ — the implied sense of the speech is "even if the testimony were against yourselves". The omission of kāna together with its noun has come in two places:
1- After conditional إن, as in the saying of the poet to al-Nuʿmān ibn al-Mundhir:
قد قيل ما قيل إن صدقا وإن كذبا ... فما انتفاعك من قول إذا قيلا
("What was said has been said, whether true or false; so what benefit do you have from a word once it has been said?")
And the implied sense is: "and if the saying was false, or if the saying was true".
2- After conditional لو, and an example of that is the saying of the poet:
لا يأمن الدهر ذو بغي ولو ملكا ... جنوده ضاق عنها السهل والجبل
("No oppressor is safe from fate, even if he be a king whose armies the plain and the mountain are too narrow to hold.")
And the implied sense is: "even if the oppressor were a king".

safi-cedvel:136-136.t:
* I'rab:
(يا أيها الذين آمنوا) its i'rab has passed «[Note: in the previous verse (135).]»; (آمنوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمنوا); (الواو) conjunctive; (رسول) maʿṭūf (conjoined) on the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) like it, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunctive; (الكتاب) conjoined on the Name of Majesty, genitive like it; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of الكتاب; (نزل) a past verb ... and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (على رسول) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نزّل), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (الكتاب) like the first; (الذي أنزل) like الذي نزّل; (من) a preposition; (قبل) a noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive by the preposition, attached to (أنزل); (الواو) conjunctive; (من) a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يكفر) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يكفر); (الواو) conjunctive in the four places; (ملائكته، كتب، رسل، اليوم) words conjoined on the Name of Majesty, genitive like it, and the pronouns in them are muḍāf ilayhi; (الآخر) a naʿt of اليوم, genitive like it; (الفاء) the connective of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (قد) a particle of realization; (ضلّ) a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (ضلالا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb); (بعيدا) naʿt, accusative.
The clause «يا أيّها الذين ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «آمنوا (the imperative one)» has no grammatical position, the answer to the vocative.
The clause «نزّل ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the first relative (الذي).
The clause «أنزل ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative (الذي).
The clause «من يكفر ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause that answers the vocative.
The clause «يكفر بالله ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «ضلّ ضلالا ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:108-108.t:
* I'rab:
(يستخفون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (من الناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يستخفون); (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negative; (يستخفون من الله) like يستخفون من الناس; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (مع) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إذ) an adverb for past time, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to the omitted khabar; (يبيتون) like يستخفون; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لا) negative; (يرضى) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (من القول) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the omitted object of يرضى.
(الواو) resumptive; (كان) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of كان, nominative; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive by al-bāʾ, attached to (محيطا).] , (يعملون) like يستخفون; (محيطا) the khabar of كان, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما يعملون) is in the position of genitive by al-bāʾ, attached to (محيطا).
The clause «يستخفون ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا يستخفون ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «هو معهم» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «يبيّتون» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لا يرضى ...» has no grammatical position, ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «كان الله ... محيطا» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يعملون» has no grammatical position, ṣila of the particle relative (ما) [Note: Or it has no grammatical position as ṣila of the nominal relative (ما).] .

* Morphology:
(يستخفون): it contains iʿlāl (phonological change) by deletion; its origin is يستخفيون; the ḍamma was transferred to the fāʾ because of its heaviness on the yāʾ — this is iʿlāl by making quiescent — then the yāʾ was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; its pattern is يستفعون.

* Rhetoric:
Majāz (figurative usage): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «محيطا»; some have placed it among the ambiguous (mutashābih) expressions.

* Benefits:
The disagreement of the grammarians about «إذ»: a- It comes as an adverb meaning «حين» ("when"), as in this verse. Ibn Hishām has several views on its i'rab:
1- It comes as a mafʿūl bihi, as in the saying of Allah the Exalted وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ كُنْتُمْ قَلِيلًا, i.e. remember your fewness.
2- It comes as a badal (substitute) of the mafʿūl bihi, as in وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتابِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ انْتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِها مَكاناً شَرْقِيًّا.
b- It may come as a particle of surprise (mufājaʾa), as in the saying of the poet:
استقدر الله خيرا وارضينّ به ... فبينما العسر إذ دارت مياسير
(Ask Allah to decree good and be content with it; for while there is hardship, suddenly ease comes round.)
c- And it comes for giving the reason, as in the saying of Allah the Exalted: وَلَنْ يَنْفَعَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ إِذْ ظَلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِي الْعَذابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ.
i.e. your sharing in the punishment will not benefit you today, because of your wrongdoing in the world.
These three views are clear; their difference is not hidden from people of skill and discernment.

safi-cedvel:109-109.t:
* I'rab:
(ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (ها) like the first; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) [Note: See the other views on the i'rab of the counterpart of this verse in verse (85) of Surat al-Baqara, especially the view of the vocative.] , (جادلتم) a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn ... and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil (agent); (عن) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جادلتم), by making it include the sense of دافعتم ("you defended"); (في الحياة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جادلتم); (الدنيا) naʿt (adjective) of الحياة, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; (من) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (يجادل) an imperfect verb, nominative; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (عنهم) like the first, attached to (يجادل); (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يجادل); (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (أم) the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one, meaning بل ("rather"); (من) like the first; (يكون) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, nominative, its noun a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (عليهم) like عنهم, attached to (وكيلا), which is the khabar of يكون, accusative.
The clause «أنتم هؤلاء ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «جادلتم ...» is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ أنتم, or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), with (قد) understood.
The clause «من يجادل ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of an implied non-jussive condition, i.e. إذا حل عليهم عذابه فمن يجادل عنهم ("when His punishment befalls them, then who will argue on their behalf?").
The clause «يجادل ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «من يكون ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يكون ... وكيلا» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (من).

* Rhetoric:
Iltifāt (shift of address): in the saying of Allah the Exalted ها أَنْتُمْ هؤُلاءِ
a variation of the address (talwīn al-khiṭāb), directing it to them by way of iltifāt, signalling that the enumeration of their crimes requires confronting them face to face with rebuke and reprimand. The iltifāt here is from the third person to the second person.

safi-cedvel:110-111.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (من) a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يعمل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (سوءا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (أو) a conjunction; (يظلم) an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to the protasis verb, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (نفس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (يستغفر) an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to يظلم, given a kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (يجد) an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), given a kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (الله) like the previous; (غفورا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (رحيما) a badal (substitute) [Note: Or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the first object.] of (غفورا), accusative like it.
The clause «من يعمل ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يعمل سوءا ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.] .
The clause «يظلم نفسه» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يعمل.
The clause «يستغفر الله» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يظلم — or يعمل.
The clause «يجد الله ...» has no grammatical position, the apodosis not joined with al-fāʾ.
(الواو) conjunction; (من يكسب إثما) like من يعمل سوءا; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (إنما) the restraining and restrained particles (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (يكسب) an imperfect verb, nominative; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (على نفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of the object pronoun al-hāʾ; (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) resumptive; (كان) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of كان, nominative; (عليما) the khabar of كان, accusative; (حكيما) a second khabar, accusative.
The clause «من يكسب ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clauses من يعمل ...
The clause «يكسب إثما ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.] .
The clause «إنما يكسبه» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with al-fāʾ.
The clause «كان الله عليما ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

safi-cedvel:112-112.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (من يكسب خطيئة) like من يعمل سوءا [Note: in verse (110) of this surah.] , (أو) a conjunction; (إثما) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to خطيئة, accusative like it; (ثم) a conjunction; (يرم) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), conjoined to يكسب, the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the weak letter, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يرم); (بريئا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (احتمل) a past verb, and the fāʿil is "huwa"; (بهتانا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (إثما) maʿṭūf to (بهتانا), accusative like it; (مبينا) naʿt (adjective) of (إثما), accusative like it.
The clause «من يكسب ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause من يكسب إثما [Note: in verse (111) of this surah.] .
The clause «يكسب خطيئة» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.] .
The clause «يرم ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يكسب خطيئة.
The clause «احتمل ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with al-fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(يرم): it contains iʿlāl (phonological change) by deletion owing to the jussive; its pattern is يفع.
(بريئا): an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the verb برىء يبرأ, of the class of فرح; its pattern is فعيل, meaning free of fault.

safi-cedvel:113-113.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لولا) a non-jussive conditional particle — of non-occurrence because of occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd) — (فضل) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and the khabar (predicate) is necessarily omitted, its implied form being "موجود" ("existing"); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (على) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (فضل); (الواو) conjunction; (رحمة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to فضل, nominative like it, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of لولا; (همت) a past verb ... and (التاء) for the feminine; (طائفة) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of طائفة; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; (يضلّوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), the sign of the subjunctive being the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يضلوك) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being بأن يضلّوك ... attached to (همت).
(الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya) [Note: Or parenthetical, and the clause after it is parenthetical with no grammatical position.] , (ما) negative; (يضلّون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (أنفس) mafʿūl bihi, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction — or resumptive — (ما يضرون) like ما يضلّون ...
and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (شيء) genitive in form, accusative in position, a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, since it is of the kind of a description of the maṣdar, i.e.: ما يضرونك ضررا ما ("they do not harm you with any harm"). (الواو) resumptive; (أنزل) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (عليك) like the first, attached to (أنزل); (الكتاب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (الحكمة) maʿṭūf to الكتاب, accusative like it; (الواو) conjunction; (علّم) like أنزل, and the fāʿil is "huwa", and (الكاف) mafʿūl bihi; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as second mafʿūl bihi; (لم) a particle of negation, the jussive and inversion (of tense); (تكن) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "anta"; (تعلم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anta"; (الواو) conjunction; (كان) an incomplete past verb; (فضل) the noun of كان, nominative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (عليك) like the first, attached to (فضل); (عظيما) the khabar of كان, accusative.
The clause «لولا فضل الله ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «همّت طائفة» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition [Note: The apodosis may be implied, i.e. لأضلوك ("they would have led you astray"), and the clause همّت resumptive, i.e. لقد همّت ("indeed a party intended") (Ḥāshiyat al-Jamal ʿalā al-Jalālayn).] .
The clause «ما يضلّون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of يضلّوك.
The clause «ما يضرونك ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl clause ... or it has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «أنزل الله ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «علّمك ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنزل الله.
The clause «تكن ...» has no grammatical position, ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «تعلم ...» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of تكن.
The clause «كان فضل الله ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنزل الله.

safi-cedvel:137-137.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; (آمنوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (ثم) a conjunction in the four places; (كفروا، آمنوا، كفروا، ازدادوا) like آمنوا; (كفرا) tamyīz (specification), accusative (manṣūb); (لم) a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; (يكن) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), vowelled with kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of يكن, nominative (marfūʿ); (اللام) the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); (يغفر) an imperfect verb, subjunctive by أن obligatorily implied after the lām of denial, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يغفر).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يغفر) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of يكن.
(الواو) conjunctive; (لا) negating; (ليهدي) like ليغفر, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", i.e. Allah.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يهديهم) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, maʿṭūf (conjoined) on the first interpreted maṣdar.
(سبيلا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «إنّ الذين آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause آمنوا.
The (second) clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause كفروا.
The (second) clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the (second) clause آمنوا.
The clause «ازدادوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the second clause كفروا.
The clause «لم يكن الله ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «يغفر لهم» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «يهديهم ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second particle relative (أن).

* Benefits:
- The lām of denial — His saying, the Exalted, ﴿لَمْ يَكُنِ اللَّهُ لِيَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ﴾: in ليغفر the lām is the lām of denial, and يغفر is subjunctive by the أن implied after it. This lām is called the lām of denial, and the imperfect after it is made subjunctive by an implied أن, like the lām of cause; or rather, the lām of cause preceded by a negated form of kāna is called the lām of denial.

safi-cedvel:138-138.t:
* I'rab:
(بشّر) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "anta"; (المنافقين) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (الباء) a preposition; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of anna; (عذابا) the noun of anna, accusative; (أليما) naʿt (adjective), accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ لهم عذابا ...) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (بشّر).
The clause «بشّر ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Rhetoric:
Sarcasm (tahakkum): in His saying, the Exalted, ﴿بَشِّرِ﴾, «بشّر» ("give glad tidings") is put in the place of "warn", in sarcasm towards them.

safi-cedvel:139-139.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of المنافقين in the previous verse «[Note: or it is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "hum" ... and the nominal clause has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
(2) Or [attached] to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of يتخذ, i.e. "they take the disbelievers as allies, passing over, in their taking, the taking of the believers" (al-Jumal).]» [Translator's note: the source has run footnote (2), which belongs to (من دون) below, into this footnote.]; (يتخذون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الكافرين) first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (أولياء) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and it is barred from nunation, its pattern أفعلاء; (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أولياء «2»; (المؤمنين) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (الهمزة) for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī); (يبتغون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (عند) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (يبتغون), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (العزّة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الفاء) causal, conveying the cause in place of the answer to the question «[Note: and the implied answer is ... "seeking honour with them is vain, for honour belongs to Allah".]»; (إن العزة لله) a particle resembling the verb, its accusative noun and its khabar; (جميعا) ḥāl, accusative, emphasizing the content of the clause.
The clause «يتخذون ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يبتغون ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «إنّ العزة لله ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive and causal.

safi-cedvel:140-140.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (قد) a particle of realization; (نزل) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نزّل); (في الكتاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نزّل); (أن) lightened from the heavy [أنّ], and its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); (إذا) an adverb of future time, in the position of the accusative, attached to the content of the apodosis; (سمعتم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and its fāʿil [Translator's note: the sentence breaks off thus in the source]; (آيات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (يكفر) an imperfect verb, passive, nominative (marfūʿ); (بها) in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (الواو) conjunctive; (يستهزأ) like يكفر, and the nāʾib fāʿil is (بها); (الفاء) the connective of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) prohibitive, making the verb jussive; (تقعدوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (مع) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (تقعدوا), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (حتى) a particle of limit and genitive; (يخوضوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive by an implied أن after حتى, the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يخوضوا) is in the position of the genitive by (حتى), attached to (تقعدوا).
(في حديث) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يخوضوا); (غير) a naʿt (adjective) of حديث, genitive like it, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن إذا سمعتم) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of (نزل).
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; (إذا) a particle of answer with no governing effect; (مثل) the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إنّ) like the first; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (جامع) khabar, nominative; (المنافقين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (الواو) conjunctive; (الكافرين) maʿṭūf (conjoined) on المنافقين, genitive like it; (في جهنم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جامع, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa because it is a diptote; (جميعا) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, from المنافقين and الكافرين, its governor being (جامع) «[Note: what permitted the ḥāl to come from the muḍāf ilayhi is that the muḍāf is the governor of the ḥāl.]».
The clause «قد نزّل عليكم» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «of the condition, its protasis and its apodosis» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of أن.
The clause «سمعتم ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يكفر بها» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from آيات الله.
The clause «يستهزأ بها» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined on the ḥāl clause.
The clause «لا تقعدوا» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «يخوضوا» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «إنّكم ... مثلهم» has no grammatical position, causal and resumptive, affirming the content of the apodosis understood from the context of the speech by the use of (إذن), i.e. "you, if you sit with them, are like them".
The clause «إن الله جامع ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(جامع): an active participle from the triliteral جمع, its pattern فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
1- «وَقَدْ نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ» is an address to the hypocrites by way of iltifāt (shift of address), conveying the intensification of the rebuke that the enumeration of their crimes calls for.
2- Simile (tashbīh): in His saying «إِنَّكُمْ إِذاً مِثْلُهُمْ». The likeness between the disbelievers and the hypocrites appears in the verse between those sitting and those sat with; for those who side with the disbelievers, ally with them and stretch out hands of abasement and humiliation to them, while able to stand firm and defy, are like the disbelievers.

* Benefits:
1- His saying, the Exalted, ﴿إِنَّكُمْ إِذاً مِثْلُهُمْ﴾: إذن is a particle of answer and requital, and here it is inoperative, with no governing effect, because it falls between the noun of inna and its khabar. Discussion of it has preceded in detail in this same sura, verse (53).
2- His saying, the Exalted, ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ جامِعُ الْمُنافِقِينَ وَالْكافِرِينَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ جَمِيعاً﴾: جميعا is a ḥāl, accusative. If it comes accusative and nunated, it is a ḥāl, as in جاء المدعوون جميعا ("the invited came all together").
But if it is attached to a pronoun referring to the noun before it, it is tawkīd (emphasis), as in: جاء المدعوون جميعهم ("the invited came, all of them").

safi-cedvel:141-141.t:
* I'rab:
(الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of المنافقين in the previous verse «[Note: or it is a badal (substitute) from it ... or a badal from the previous relative in His saying: الذين يتخذون الكافرين ..., because the address is with the believers.]»; (يتربصون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الباء) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يتربصون); (الفاء) resumptive; (إن) a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive; (كان) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (لكم) like بكم, attached to the fronted khabar (predicate) of kāna; (فتح) the delayed noun of kāna, nominative; (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of فتح; (قالوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الهمزة) for interrogation; (لم) a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; (نكن) an incomplete imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "naḥnu"; (معكم) an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to the khabar of نكن ... and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunctive; (إن كان ... نستحوذ) like its counterpart above; (عليكم) like بكم, attached to (نستحوذ); (الواو) conjunctive; (نمنع) an imperfect verb, jussive, maʿṭūf (conjoined) on نستحوذ, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is "naḥnu"; (من المؤمنين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نمنعكم), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (الفاء) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (يحكم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (يحكم), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يحكم); (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الواو) conjunctive; (لن) a particle of negation, subjunctive and the future; (يجعل) an imperfect verb, subjunctive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (للكافرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يجعل), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (على المؤمنين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (سبيلا) «[Note: or attached to (يجعل).]», which is mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «يتربصون ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «كان لكم فتح» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «قالوا» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «لم نكن معكم» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «كان للكافرين نصيب» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause كان لكم فتح.
The (second) clause «قالوا» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «لم نستحوذ ...» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «نمنعكم» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined on the maqūl al-qawl clause.
The clause «الله يحكم ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive «[Note: it is permissible for it to be conjoined on the previous resumptive clause.]».
The clause «يحكم بينكم» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «لن يجعل الله ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause الله يحكم.

* Morphology:
(فتح): an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb فتح يفتح, of the third bāb, its pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- «الَّذِينَ يَتَرَبَّصُونَ بِكُمْ» is a variation of the address (talwīn al-khiṭāb) and its turning to the believers, enumerating some others of the crimes and vile deeds of the hypocrites.
2- If you say: why did He call the victory of the Muslims a "conquest" (فتح) and the victory of the disbelievers a "share" (نصيب)?
I say: to magnify the standing of the Muslims and to belittle the lot of the disbelievers, because the victory of the Muslims is a great matter for which the gates of heaven are opened so that it descends upon His friends; as for the victory of the disbelievers, it is nothing but a lowly lot and a morsel of this world that they obtain. And calling the victory the Muslims attained a "conquest" is of the type of majāz mursal (metonymic trope), in view of what the victory leads to.

safi-cedvel:142-142.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (المنافقين) the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (يخادعون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الواو) circumstantial; (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (خادع) khabar (predicate), nominative, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunctive; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second (قاموا); (قاموا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (إلى الصلاة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قاموا); (قاموا) like the first; (كسالى) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (يراءون) an imperfect verb like يخادعون; (الناس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunctive; (لا) negating; (يذكرون الله) like يخادعون الله; (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (قليلا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), for it is its description «[Note: or a mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), accusative, standing in for the adverb, for it is its description, i.e. "except for a little time".]», accusative, i.e. "except a little remembrance".
The clause «إنّ المنافقين ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يخادعون ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.
