The clause «هو خادعهم» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl «[Note: it is permissible for it to be conjoined on the khabar clause of inna, and permissible for it to be resumptive.]».
The clause «قاموا إلى الصلاة» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قاموا كسالى» has no grammatical position, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; and the condition, its protasis and apodosis are conjoined on the khabar of inna.
The clause «يراءون ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl «[Note: it is permissible for it to be resumptive, and so to have no grammatical position.]».
The clause «لا يذكرون ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined on the clause يراءون.

* Morphology:
(خادع): an active participle from the triliteral خدع, on the pattern فاعل, and it has been annexed to the object.
(كسالى): plural of كسل or كسلان, from كسل يكسل, of the bāb فرح; the pattern of كسل is فعل with fatḥa then kasra, the pattern of كسلان is فعلان with fatḥa on the fāʾ, and the pattern of كسالى is فعالى with ḍamma on the fāʾ; the fatḥa is also permissible in a different reading.
(يراءون): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is يرائيون; the vowel was felt heavy on the yāʾ, so it was made quiescent — iʿlāl by making quiescent — and the hamza was given its vowel; two quiescent letters met, so the first was deleted to escape the meeting of two quiescents; its pattern is يفاعون.

* Rhetoric:
«وَهُوَ خادِعُهُمْ»
That is, He does with them what the one who prevails in deception does, in that He left them in this world with their blood and property protected, and prepared for them in the Hereafter the lowest depth of the Fire.
And His deception, Glorified and Exalted is He, is of the type of mushākala (verbal correspondence).

safi-cedvel:143-143.t:
* I'rab:
(مذبذبين) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), from the fāʿil (agent) of يراءون, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) مذبذبين; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and (اللام) the lām of distance and (الكاف) for address; (لا) negating; (إلى) a preposition; (ها) a particle of alerting; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the pronoun of مذبذبين, which is its governor, i.e. "not attributed to these ..."; (الواو) conjunctive; (لا إلى هؤلاء) like the first; (الواو) resumptive; (من) a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (يضلل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), vowelled with kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (الفاء) the connective of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لن) a particle of negation and subjunctive; (تجد) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "anta"; (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a ḥāl from (سبيلا) «[Note: or attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi, if (تجد) is taken as transitive to two objects.]», which is mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «يضلل الله ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لن تجد ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of a jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(مذبذبين): plural of مذبذب, a passive participle from the quadriliteral ذبذب, its pattern مفعلل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the first lām.

* Rhetoric:
«مُذَبْذَبِينَ بَيْنَ ذلِكَ», i.e. wavering between the two, bewildered, Satan having made them waver. The origin of al-dhabdhaba is the sound of the movement of a hanging thing; then it was borrowed (istiʿāra) for every agitation and movement.

* Benefits:
His saying, the Exalted, about the hypocrites: ﴿مُذَبْذَبِينَ بَيْنَ ذلِكَ لا إِلى هؤُلاءِ وَلا إِلى هؤُلاءِ﴾ — this verse draws a wonderful artistic picture of the state of the hypocrites: they are forever swinging and shaking, never settling or holding firm in one state. The words of this verse and its meanings come to share in drawing this picture: the adjective (مذبذبين), by its sound and rhythm, depicts the trembling and constant shaking that never settles, and His saying, the Exalted, ﴿لا إِلى هؤُلاءِ وَلا إِلى هؤُلاءِ﴾ depicts the swinging and lack of steadiness. It is a picture that the imagination and the senses contemplate more wonderfully than what the eye sees and the artist's brush draws.

safi-cedvel:144-144.t:
* I'rab:
(يأيها الذين آمنوا) its i'rab has passed «[Note: in verse (135) of this sura.]»; (لا) prohibitive, making the verb jussive; (تتخذوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الكافرين) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (أولياء) a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أولياء «[Note: or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun latent in أولياء, or from the fāʿil of (تتخذوا) ... and see verse (139) of this sura.]»; (المؤمنين) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (الهمزة) for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī); (تريدون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; (تجعلوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تجعلوا) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, its governor being تريدون.
(لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi of the verb تجعلوا; (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl from (سلطانا) «[Note: see the i'rab of verse (91) of this sura.]» — a naʿt (adjective) that came before what it qualifies —; (سلطانا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (مبينا) naʿt, accusative.
The vocative clause «أيها الذين ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لا تتخذوا» has no grammatical position, the answer to the vocative.
The clause «تريدون ...» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «تجعلوا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).

safi-cedvel:147-147.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (يفعل) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (بعذاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يفعل), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إن) a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive; (شكرتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) ... and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil; (الواو) conjunctive; (آمنتم) like شكرتم.
(الواو) resumptive; (كان) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of kāna, nominative; (شاكرا) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative (manṣūb); (عليما) a second khabar, accusative.
The clause «يفعل الله» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «شكرتم» has no grammatical position, resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "if you are grateful, then what would Allah do with punishing you?".
The clause «آمنتم» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause شكرتم.
The clause «كان الله شاكرا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Benefits:
Interrogative ما: it is an indeclinable noun, and it falls in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) in the following cases:
1- When a noun follows it, as in: ما ليلة القدر؟ ("What is the Night of Decree?")
2- When an intransitive verb follows it, as in: ما يقوم مقامك؟ ("What takes your place?")
3- When a transitive verb follows it that has taken its full object, as in: ما حملك على ذلك؟ ("What led you to that?")
And it is parsed as a fronted mafʿūl bihi when a transitive verb follows it that has not taken its object, as in: ما تشاء مني؟ ("What do you want from me?"), ما قرأت؟ ("What did you read?").
And it is parsed as in the position of the accusative as the khabar of kāna or one of its sisters when an incomplete verb follows it, as in:
ما أصبح عملك؟ ("What has your work become?"), ما كان شأنك؟ ("What was your affair?").
Remark: sometimes ذا enters upon it, so that it becomes ماذا. Then either we parse the whole as a single compound in such-and-such a position according to what we have mentioned, or «ما» is parsed as an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and ذا as a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as khabar.

safi-cedvel:145-146.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ المنافقين) as the previous one «[Note: in verse (142) of this sura.]»; (في الدرك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of inna; (الأسفل) a naʿt (adjective) of الدرك, genitive (majrūr) like it; (من النار) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الدرك; (الواو) conjunctive; (لن تجد لهم نصيرا) like لن تجد له سبيلا «[Note: in verse (143) of this sura.]».
The clause «إنّ المنافقين ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لن تجد لهم ...» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined on the khabar of inna «[Note: it is permissible for it to be resumptive.
The yāʾ was dropped from the Quranic script for lightness, because of the meeting of two quiescent letters.
(2, 3) Some permitted making it the khabar of the relative (الذين), taking it as a mubtadaʾ (subject) and taking the fāʾ as redundant (zāʾida).]» [Translator's note: the source has run footnotes 2 and 3, which belong to (يؤتي) and to the clause «أولئك مع المؤمنين» below, into this footnote.]
(إلا) a particle of exception; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the excepted in a discontinuous exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ); (تابوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الواو) conjunctive; (أصلحوا) like تابوا; (الواو) conjunctive; (اعتصموا) like تابوا; (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اعتصموا); (الواو) conjunctive; (أخلصوا) like تابوا; (دين) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لله) like بالله, attached to (أخلصوا); (الفاء) resumptive — or redundant, for linking, because of the sense of condition in the speech connected with الذين —; (أولئك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ ... and (الكاف) for address; (مع) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (المؤمنين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (الواو) conjunctive; (سوف) a particle of the future; (يؤتي) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ «2»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (المؤمنين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (أجرا) a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (عظيما) naʿt, accusative.
The clause «تابوا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «أصلحوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the ṣila clause.
The clause «اعتصموا» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the ṣila clause.
The clause «أخلصوا» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the ṣila clause.
The clause «أولئك مع المؤمنين» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) «3».
The clause «سوف يؤتي الله» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause أولئك مع ...

* Morphology:
(الدرك): a noun for the furthest bottom of Hell, its pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(الأسفل): a derived adjective from سفل يسفل, of the bāb نصر, the bāb فرح and the bāb كرم, its pattern أفعل, and it carries the sense of preference (tafḍīl).

safi-cedvel:148-148.t:
* I'rab:
(لا) negating; (يحبّ) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); (الله) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (الجهر) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (بالسوء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) الجهر; (من القول) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from السوء; (إلّا) a particle of exception; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the excepted in a continuous exception (istithnāʾ muttaṣil) from the word الجهر بالسوء, and that is with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "except the public utterance of one who has been wronged" «[Note: or [excepted] from the implied thing excepted from, which is (من أحد); it is also permissible for it to be in the position of the genitive as a badal (substitute) from the word excepted from ... and it is permissible for the exception to be discontinuous.]»; (ظلم) a past verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", and it is the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid); (الواو) resumptive; (كان) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of kāna, nominative; (سميعا) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative; (عليما) a second khabar, accusative.
The clause «لا يحبّ الله ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ظلم ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «كان الله سميعا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(الجهر): an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb جهر يجهر, of the bāb فتح, its pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; and there are other maṣdars, namely جهارا with kasra on the jīm, and جهرة with the addition of tāʾ marbūṭa «[Note: and see verse (55) of Sūrat al-Baqara.]».

* Rhetoric:
His not loving something, Glorified and Exalted is He, is a kināya (metonymy) for His anger.

safi-cedvel:149-149.t:
* I'rab:
(إن) a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive; (تبدوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is an attached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); (خيرا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (أو) a conjunction; (تخفوا) like تبدوا and maʿṭūf (conjoined) on it, and (الهاء) an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (أو) a conjunction; (تعفوا) like تبدوا and conjoined on it; (عن سوء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تعفوا); (الفاء) the connective of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) — or causal —; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (كان) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (عفوا) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative; (قديرا) a second khabar, accusative.
The clause «إن تبدوا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تخفوه» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the resumptive clause.
The clause «تعفوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the resumptive clause.
The clause «إنّ الله كان ...» has no grammatical position, causal, giving the cause of the omitted apodosis, which is: "then pardon is better for you".
The clause «كان عفوا ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.

* Morphology:
(تبدوا - تخفوا - تعفوا): they contain iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion, in that the weak letter — the lām of the word — was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters «[Note: and see verse (33) of Sūrat al-Baqara.]».

safi-cedvel:152-152.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (آمنوا بالله ورسله) like يكفرون بالله ورسله above «[Note: in verse (150) of this sura.]», though the verb here is past; (الواو) conjunctive; (لم) a particle of negation and jussive; (يفرّقوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (بين) an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يفرّقوا); (أحد) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of أحد; (أولئك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.. and (الكاف) a particle of address; (سوف) a particle of the future; (يؤتي) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أجور) a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) resumptive; (كان الله غفورا رحيما) like كان الله عفوّا قديرا «[Note: in verse (149) of this sura.]».
The clause «الذين آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the resumptive clause «[Note: in verse (150) of this sura.]».
The clause «آمنوا بالله ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.
The clause «لم يفرّقوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the ṣila clause.
The clause «أولئك سوف يؤتيهم ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (الذين).
The clause «سوف يؤتيهم ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «كان الله غفورا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

safi-cedvel:150-151.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna, the particle resembling the verb; (يكفرون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يكفرون); (الواو) conjunctive; (رسل) maʿṭūf (conjoined) on the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) like it, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunctive; (يريدون) like يكفرون; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; (يفرّقوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يفرّقوا) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governor being يريدون.
(بين) an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (يفرّقوا); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; (رسل) conjoined on the Name of Majesty by the wāw, genitive like it, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (يقولون) like يكفرون; (نؤمن) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "naḥnu"; (ببعض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نؤمن); (الواو) conjunctive; (نكفر ببعض) like نؤمن ببعض; (الواو) conjunctive; (يريدون أن يتّخذوا) like يريدون أن يفرّقوا; (بين) like the first, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi whose governor is يتّخذوا; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (سبيلا) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative, i.e. "to take a middle position between faith and disbelief".
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يتّخذوا) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, its governor being the second يريدون.
The clause «إنّ الذين يكفرون ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «يكفرون ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يريدون ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the ṣila clause.
The clause «يفرّقوا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «يقولون» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause يريدون.
The clause «نؤمن ...» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «نكفر ...» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined on the maqūl al-qawl clause.
The (second) clause «يريدون» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the (first) clause يريدون.
The clause «يتّخذوا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
(151) (أولئك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).. and (الكاف) a particle of address; (هم) a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: or a nominative pronoun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar (predicate) is الكافرون, and the clause هم الكافرون is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك.]»; (الكافرون) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (حقّا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and it emphasizes the content of the clause before it; (الواو) resumptive; (أعتدنا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn..
and (نا) an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; (للكافرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أعتدنا); (عذابا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (مهينا) naʿt (adjective), accusative.
The clause «أولئك هم الكافرون» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «أعتدنا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Rhetoric:
Putting the overt noun in place of the pronoun: in His saying, the Exalted, ﴿وَأَعْتَدْنا لِلْكافِرِينَ﴾, where the overt noun was put in place of the pronoun, as a reminder of the hideous attribute of disbelief, which signals the cause.

* Benefits:
His saying, the Exalted: ﴿أُولئِكَ هُمُ الْكافِرُونَ حَقًّا﴾ — حقا has two parsings. The first: a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, its implied form being "that is truly true" (حقّ ذلك حقا). The second: that it is a ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied sense being "those are the disbelievers without doubt". But the stronger is that it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq, since it is a maṣdar (verbal noun), and the maṣdar is non-derived (jāmid), whereas the ḥāl comes derived ... unless it can be interpreted by a derived word, as in: كرّ عليّ أسدا ("he charged at me [like] a lion"), which you interpret as كرّ عليّ شجاعا ("he charged at me bravely"). However, when two parsings are equally possible in a word, one needing an implied element and the other not, then not implying is preferable.

safi-cedvel:153-153.t:
* I'rab:
(يسأل) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أهل) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (الكتاب) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; (تنزّل) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" «[Translator's note: so in the source; since the verb addresses the Prophet ﷺ, the expected implied form is "anta".]»; (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تنزّل); (كتابا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (من السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تنزّل) «[Note: or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (كتابا).]»; (الفاء) causal «[Note: it is permissible for it to be the connective of the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you consider what they asked enormous, then they asked Moses.."]»; (قد) a particle of realization; (سألوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma..
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (موسى) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (أكبر) a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من) a preposition; (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. And (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address. [Translator's note: so in the source; ذلك here is governed by the preposition من.]
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تنزّل) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the verb يسألك.
(الفاء) conjunctive; (فقالوا) like سألوا; (أرنا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anta"; (الله) the Name of Majesty, a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (جهرة) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), for it is a kind of seeing in general «[Note: it is permissible for it to be a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "they said that openly".]»; (الفاء) conjunctive, linking the effect to the cause; (أخذت) a past verb ... and (التاء) for the feminine, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الصاعقة) fāʿil, nominative; (بظلم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أخذتهم), and the bāʾ is causal, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (اتّخذوا العجل) like سألوا موسى, and the second object is omitted, its implied form being "as a god"; (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اتخذوا); (ما) a maṣdar-forming (maṣdarī) particle; (جاءتهم) like أخذتهم; (البيّنات) fāʿil, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما جاءتهم البيّنات) is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
(الفاء) conjunctive; (عفونا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil; (عن) a preposition; (ذلك) like the first, attached to (عفونا); (الواو) conjunctive; (آتينا) like عفونا; (موسى) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif; (سلطانا) a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (مبينا) naʿt, accusative.
The clause «يسألك أهل ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «تنزّل ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative.
The clause «سألوا ...» has no grammatical position, causal, for omitted speech, i.e. "do not mind their asking".
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause سألوا as an explicative conjunction.
The clause «أرنا ...» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «أخذتهم الصاعقة» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause قالوا.
The clause «اتّخذوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause أخذتهم الصاعقة.
The clause «جاءتهم البيّنات» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «عفونا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause اتّخذوا ...
The clause «آتينا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause عفونا.

safi-cedvel:154-154.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive; (رفعنا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn..
and (نا) a pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); (فوق) an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (رفعنا), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الطور) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (بميثاق) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb (رفعنا), and the bāʾ is causal, i.e. "because of their breaking their covenant", and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (قلنا) like رفعنا; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (قلنا); (ادخلوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الباب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (سجّدا) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, from the fāʿil of ادخلوا; (الواو) conjunctive; (قلنا لهم) like the first; (لا) prohibitive, making the verb jussive; (تعدوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (في السبت) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تعدوا); (الواو) conjunctive; (أخذنا) like رفعنا; (منهم) like لهم, attached to (أخذنا); (ميثاقا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (غليظا) naʿt (adjective), accusative.
The clause «رفعنا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause آتينا «[Note: in the previous verse (153).]».
The clause «قلنا لهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause رفعنا.
The clause «ادخلوا ...» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The (second) clause «قلنا لهم» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the (first) clause قلنا.
The clause «لا تعدوا ...» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «أخذنا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause قلنا.

safi-cedvel:155-158.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (الباء) a preposition of causation; (ما) redundant (zāʾida); (نقض) genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being (لعناهم) «[Note: at the beginning of al-Māʾida the verb came stated explicitly; Allah the Exalted said: «فبما نقضهم ميثاقهم لعنّاهم ...» (verse 13).]», and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ميثاق) the object of the maṣdar نقض, accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (كفرهم) like نقضهم and maʿṭūf (conjoined) on it; (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the maṣdar (كفر); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunctive; (قتلهم الأنبياء) like نقضهم ميثاقهم; (بغير) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "wrongfully"; (حق) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunctive; (قولهم) like نقضهم and conjoined on it; (قلوب) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (غلف) khabar (predicate), nominative; (بل) for transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī); (طبع) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (على) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (طبع); (بكفر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (طبع), and the bāʾ is causal, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunctive, linking the effect to the cause; (لا) negating; (يؤمنون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (قليلا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), for it is its description «[Note: or a mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), because it stands in for the adverb, i.e. "a little time".. And it is not valid to make it an exception from the agent pronoun in يؤمنون, because these have had their hearts sealed; it may be valid to make it an exception from the pronoun in (عليها).]», accusative.
The implied clause «(لعنّاهم)» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «قلوبنا غلف» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «طبع الله عليها» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «لا يؤمنون ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause طبع الله ...
(156) (الواو) conjunctive; (بكفرهم) like the first, attached to the implied verb لعنّاهم; (الواو) conjunctive; (قولهم) like كفرهم and conjoined on it; (على مريم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the maṣdar (قول), by its carrying the sense of their lying and their persisting, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, for it is a diptote; (بهتانا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative «[Note: or a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, for it is a kind of it, i.e. "their saying the saying of slander".]»; (عظيما) naʿt (adjective), accusative.
(157) (الواو) conjunctive; (قولهم) conjoined on the first قولهم, genitive like it; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; (قتلنا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.. and (نا) the fāʿil; (المسيح) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (عيسى) a badal (substitute) from المسيح, accusative like it, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (بن) a naʿt of عيسى, accusative like it, or a badal from it; (مريم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, for it is a diptote; (رسول) a naʿt of عيسى, accusative, or a badal from it, or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) «[Note: it is permissible for His saying (رسول الله) to be from the speech of Allah the Exalted and not from what they said, in praise of him; then the pause is on what precedes it, and رسول is accusative by an omitted verb, its implied form being "I praise".]»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) resumptive; (ما) negating; (قتلوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الواو) conjunctive; (ما صلبوه) like ما قتلوه; (الواو) conjunctive; (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk); (شبّه) a past verb, passive, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa"; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (شبّه); (الواو) conjunctive; (إنّ) like the first; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; (اختلفوا) like قتلوا; (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of the genitive, attached to (اختلفوا); (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), conveying emphasis; (في شك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of inna; (منه) like فيه, attached to a naʿt of شك; (ما) negating; (لهم) like the first, attached to a fronted khabar; (به) like فيه, attached to a ḥāl from علم; (من) a redundant preposition; (علم) genitive in form, nominative in position, as a delayed mubtadaʾ; (إلّا) a particle of exception; (اتّباع) the excepted, accusative in a discontinuous exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ); (الظنّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunctive; (ما قتلوه) like the first; (يقينا) mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative, standing in for the maṣdar, for it is its description, i.e. "they did not kill him a certain killing" «[Note: it is permissible for it to be a ḥāl emphasizing the negation of the killing, i.e. "the killing is negated with emphatic certainty".]».
The clause «إنّا قتلنا ...» is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl of the maṣdar قولهم.
The clause «قتلنا المسيح» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «ما قتلوه» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «ما صلبوه» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause ما قتلوه.
The clause «لكن شبّه لهم» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause ما قتلوه; and the clause «إنّ الذين اختلفوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause ما قتلوه.
The clause «اختلفوا ...» has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «ما لهم به من علم» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) «[Note: or parenthetical, and the clause ما قتلوه يقينا is conjoined on the first clause ما قتلوه.]».
The clause «ما قتلوه ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined on the clause ما لهم به من علم.
(158) (بل) for invalidating digression (iḍrāb ibṭālī); (رفع) like طبع, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (إليه) like فيه, attached to (رفع); (الواو) conjunctive; (كان الله عزيزا حكيما) like كان الله سميعا عليما «[Note: in verse (148) of this sura.]».
The clause «رفعه الله» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
The clause «كان الله عزيزا ...» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

* Morphology:
(نقض): an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb نقض ينقض, of the bāb نصر, its pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(اتّباع): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the five-letter verb اتّبع, its pattern افتعال, on the pattern of the past with kasra on the third letter and an alif added before the last.
(شكّ): an aural maṣdar of the verb شكّ يشكّ, of the bāb نصر, its pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn, and its ʿayn has been assimilated into its lām.
(يقينا): a resembling adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from يقن ييقن, of the bāb فرح, its pattern فعيل.
